head: Middleware
title: Middleware
text: The middleware is the layer in panel.py every HTTP request passes before an endpoint reads it: kill switch, foreign pages (CSRF), size of the request and update lock. On the way back it sets protective headers, writes changes to the admin log and renews logins.

head: Middleware
title: Why
text: Why: FastAPI reads file, form and JSON parts before an endpoint checks the login. Without this layer anyone could fill memory or disk with a huge upload and would get the „not logged in“ only afterwards. Likewise the kill switch must hold before any endpoint does anything, and a foreign web page must never use the browser's cookies for changes.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A request arrives: Every HTTP request to the panel passes this layer, from the outside in, in the order Starlette stacks the middleware (the one added last is outermost). Telegram, „Ask Spark“ over MCP and the speakers build their question inside the panel and call chat.chat directly; their outer request already passed here. 2. Start the clock: slow_reads times the whole request. A read under /api/ that takes longer than 1.5 s becomes one journal line, per route at most every 60 s; only the route's pattern and the time, never the query or names. 3. My kill switch for this key?: If the request carries a device key and that key's profile has its own kill switch on, it gets nothing but the kill switch state. Otherwise the panel notes which profile this request acts for, so the last line of defence further down knows whose action it would be. 4. Kill switch on?: With the kill switch off the request goes straight on to the origin check. The page itself and its files always pass, so the kill switch can be seen and lifted. 5. From outside?: In the home network is only who has a private address and does not come through a proxy, or comes through a listed proxy that reports a private add

head: Way
title: Way
text: ress. From kill switch stage 1 everything from outside only gets the page and the kill switch state. 6. All quiet?: In stage 3 only logins, lifting the kill switch and reading status, logs and live pass, also at home. In the stages below everything at home goes on; the panel then holds actions off further down. 7. Foreign page?: A changing request (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) that carries a login cookie must come from the panel's own page: the browser says so with Sec-Fetch-Site, else Origin is compared with the host. Another port on the same machine counts as foreign. With neither header it is not a browser (scripts) and passes. 8. Big upload without login?: The paths for big uploads (backups, voices, sound, documents, pictures, music, MCP) only accept someone who could be logged in at all: admin cookie, profile or an Authorization line. Another Spark's file (/api/verbund/blob) only when Verbund and files are on and the sender is an allowed Spark with a known key. The real check comes later in the endpoint; here no byte of a stranger's upload is read. 9. Too large?: Every path has its limit, else a small default of two MB holds. A Content-Length that is too large is refused at once;

head: Way
title: Way
text: while reading, BodyLimit also counts and stops as soon as more arrives than allowed. 10. Update running?: While an update runs, changes under /api/ are held. The assistant, the devices and logging in stay open (update.UNLOCKED). 11. Endpoint: Only now the endpoint reads the request and checks login, profile and rate limit itself (the next box, „Login, profile“). With the usage counter on, the request first notes which profile it runs for: what it asks the models counts for that profile. 12. Answer with protection: Every answer gets the protective headers (no foreign frames, a strict Content-Security-Policy, on https also HSTS), under /api/ „no-store“. A change goes into the admin log with who, path and status, except normal use from guard.QUIET_WHY. Logins in use are renewed, on https always with Secure.

title: Examples
text: Examples: Setting in the browser at home: Passes: the endpoint checks the login, the change is in the admin log. · Foreign web page sends a form: Refused with 403 before any endpoint acts. · Kill switch stage 1, app on the road: Blocked with 503 and the stage; the app shows the kill switch. · Big upload without login: Refused with 401, not a byte read.

head: Why this order
title: Why this order
text: - The kill switch is outermost: with it on, even a foreign page or an oversized upload from outside only hears the stage. - Origin comes before size: a foreign page is refused without its content being read. - What the kill switch holds off deep down (NotausAktiv) is answered as a plain sentence with 503, never as a server error.

head: Security
title: Security
text: How the Spark's layers of protection work together. The principle: the language model proposes, the panel decides. Rights, locks, actions and borders are settled by the panel with fixed rules in the code; what comes from outside (web, mail, calendar, documents, Telegram, Home Assistant, model output) is data and never a command. This page shows one question's way through every layer; the single boxes have their own pages.

head: Security
title: Why
text: Why: A language model can be talked into things by text it reads. So it may decide nothing that touches rights, money, devices or other people's data. Every layer can only narrow, none can allow what an earlier one forbade (order: rights, locks, intent).

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A question or order comes in: At home directly, on the way only through the reverse proxy with TLS. Every device has its own key or signs in like the browser. Every way in (panel, device keys, calendar and contacts apps, MCP, other Sparks, Wyoming, phone, Telegram, the anchors and the web terminal of remote access, the spontaneous help page) stands with its protection in the security docs under "Ways in". 2. Does the kill switch allow it?: The kill switch has three stages from the outside in: stage 1 closes the internet, stage 2 every action, stage 3 every conversation. No model, mail or document can trigger or lift it. 3. Signed in and within limits?: Size limit and origin check (CSRF) before reading, then a rate limit per address and a cap on parallel requests for the model, recognition and output (guard.Slot). Secrets, roles and backups also need a fresh code or passkey (core.confirm_code, 10 minutes). A whole area can be unlocked for a while with a second step (rule "unlocking an area", first remote access: 5 to 120 minutes, fernzugang.entsperrt_bis): this login only, from the same place only, locked on Lock, logout and the kill switch; pairing and removing still ask every t

head: Way
title: Way
text: ime. The models on tars are reached only through the TLS-Tor; commands there are checked by the Wärter (tarswart.check: signature, time, one-time number, one of 16 fixed commands). 4. Who asks, surely known?: The profile comes from the cookie, the app key or a linked account. At a shared speaker the device key is not enough: chat_turn.shared_stranger allows personal things only when the owner's voice is surely recognised in the same recording. 5. Release and block: Every function is off until the admin releases it; then it counts for every profile, unless the admin blocks single ones (features.blocked). What is not allowed is not even offered as a tool. 6. Outside stays data: What a tool reads from outside reaches the model as a marked block of data (textnorm.defuse: the block's end and the model's own markers such as „<|im_start|>“ or „<tool_call>“ are defused; the LLM-Tor does it once more for every message, llm_tor.entschaerft). From then on 13 acting tools are locked, in the next turn too, and nothing of it is learned into memory; after a mail it is 19, everything that asks the internet among them (web search, Wikipedia, weather, transit), so no search word carries mail content

Home Assistant only from an allowlist. Only the person deletes mail (into the trash, for good only after a question), never the model. Buttons on cards in the conversation and on the page Open are fixed names (vorgaenge.AKTIONE

head: Way

text: N); the panel checks every press (owner, kind, state, kill switch, the module's switches), and what would send or enter something without a proposal only opens the page where the person does it. 9. Check the answer: Times, dates and amounts that are nowhere in the sources are dropped (answercheck.unsupported). Passwords, codes and keys are never spoken (textnorm.hide_secrets). The pages never show model text as HTML. 10. Traces: Logs carry only fixed words and numbers. Changes to access and protection are written by guard.log with a SHA-256 chain; the Wachposten tells the admins about anything unusual. Secrets lie sealed in the vault (vault.seal).

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: A mail demands an action: The mail is read, but nothing is switched: the tools for it are locked. · A web page with a fake system line: „<|im_start|>system“ arrives defused as text, the model sees no new role; it could not act anyway. · A stranger's voice at the speaker: An answer as for a guest, without mails or appointments. · Switch off the light: Switched only after „yes“. · Kill switch stage 3: No conversation, only the kill switch page.

head: The borders
title: The borders
text: - A, in from outside: only through the reverse proxy with TLS; every endpoint checks sign-in, profile, CSRF, size and rate limit. - B, devices at home: one key per device; at a shared speaker the voice counts as well. - C, the Spark reads outside things: only through the guard, no home network without permission, the checked address pinned; what comes back is data. - D, panel to the models: TLS 1.3 with the certificate pinned at the pairing; the models listen on 127.0.0.1 only. - E, handles on tars: only fixed commands of the Wärter, signed, with time and one-time number.

title: Standards
text: - OWASP ASVS 5.0 level 2 (sign-in and admin level 3), OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications 2025, BSI TR-02102; the security checklist with its part „State of the art“ names what is still missing.

head: Login, profile
title: Login, profile
text: Here the panel decides who sends a request and what that person may do: login with password or PIN (with a lock after wrong attempts), cookie or device key, rate limit and the release per function. The profile comes only from the cookie, the key or the panel itself, never from a request's text or from the model.

head: Login, profile
title: Why
text: Why: The Spark is reachable in the home network and often through a proxy from the internet. Without a lock a PIN could be guessed, without a rate limit one page or script could take the GPU for itself, and without a fixed binding to a profile a request could pretend to be someone else.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Log in or ask: Logging in gives the browser a cookie; apps, watch and speakers have a device key instead, calendar and contacts apps (kalenderserver.py, kontaktserver.py) an app password that locks like a PIN. Steps 2 to 5 run once when logging in, the steps from 6 on with every request. 2. Locked?: Locks are kept per address and per name (or the admin password). A name's lock does not hold for a browser that logged in to that name before (cookie speech_known, only its hash is kept). So a stranger guessing cannot lock the owner out. 3. Password or PIN right?: The check runs in its own thread. An unknown name costs the same work as a wrong PIN, the answer is the same. A wrong attempt waits a second, counts for the lock and, when it comes from outside, for „Emergency stop by itself“. 4. Second step?: If the profile (or the admin) has the second step on and the browser is not trusted, the code from the app or a passkey comes next. A wrong code counts like a wrong PIN. 5. Set the cookie: The address's counter is cleared; strangers' wrong attempts for the name keep counting. The profile cookie is signed and stands in the list of signed-in browsers; it holds at most 90 days without us

head: Way
title: Way
text: e and is renewed while used. The admin cookie is signed with the password, a key of this Spark only and the second step. When the second step was part of it (code, passkey or a trusted browser) the session carries its mark: only then does a profile's admin role count, without an admin sign-in of its own. Then the panel reads the profile's calendars and mail ahead in the background (vorwaermen.py, at most every 600 seconds), so its pages open at once. 6. Find the profile: First what only the panel itself sets (Telegram, „Ask Spark“ over MCP), then the device key (only its hash is stored), then the cookie: signature, age, session still in the list and not logged out. 7. Key free for this path?: A key with a scope (app, watch, room, Home Assistant, writing help, companion, terminal) only reaches its own paths and only while the admin and the profile have the function on. If it is off right now or the profile has its own kill switch on, the panel answers 503 instead of 401, so the app keeps its pairing. 8. No profile and guest access off?: Without a profile only the admin passes (cookie or HTTP Basic, whose wrong attempts count like on the login page), or anybody when the admin opened

head: Way
title: Way
text: the assistant without password. Guests then only get question and answer. 9. Too many requests?: Per profile, else per address, the panel counts the requests of the last minute: in the chat 120 for a profile or the admin, 30 for a guest. 10. Guest, all places taken?: Guests share 4 places at once in the chat. A place nobody frees counts as free again after 10 minutes. 11. Release per function: For every function the panel asks in a fixed order: the admin's switch (and the one of the function it builds on), guest (never gets one), blocked by the admin for the profile, the profile's own wish, second step needed. It is read anew with every request, so a change holds at once. 12. On to preparing: The request goes on with its profile (or as a guest) to chat_turn.prepare. Speech gets priority over background work, and the profile's other open pages see „answering“.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Login with PIN: Logged in: the browser has a signed cookie. · Admin profile signs in with its code: Signed in and admin at once: the session carries the second step's mark. · Stranger guesses a PIN: Refused; after 5 wrong attempts the address is locked. · Question from the iPhone app: Passes: profile from the device key, releases per function. · Guest, guest access off: Refused with 401: no assistant without a profile.

head: Behind a proxy
title: Behind a proxy
text: - X-Forwarded-For only counts from a listed proxy (or one on the Spark itself while none is listed). Otherwise any device could claim another address and get around the lock.

head: Logging out
title: Logging out
text: - A logged-out cookie becomes invalid on the server too, a copy of it no longer works. For the admin this holds for every copy of the same login.

head: Prepare request
title: Prepare request
text: chat_turn.prepare turns a chat request into a finished turn before the language model is asked: who speaks and what that person may do, the system prompt, answers to questions back and proposals, the locks after outside text and the list of offered tools.

head: Prepare request
title: Why
text: Why: The model should only see what it may really use in this turn. Everything that decides (rights, locks, a „yes“ to a proposal, the choice after a question back) the panel does here by fixed rules; the model only says the result afterwards.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Read the messages: Only text messages of user and assistant are taken, each cut at 20000 characters. An answer the browser marked as made from mail or outside text keeps that mark. A question from the Android app's assistant sheet only passes when „Android: Spark as assistant“ is released for the profile (else 403). 2. Trim history, carry the lock: The history is trimmed to its budget. If an answer from outside text is among the last three messages, this turn starts locked; older ones are not sent at all. When the person asks for a song in their own words, such an answer up to 7 messages back stays along as data (chords, style). A screen description only comes along as a fixed note and locks nothing. 3. Guest or unknown voice?: Without a profile, or at an own speaker or phone when speech recognition did not clearly hear the profile's voice (on the phone: and no phone PIN was typed), there is only question and answer: no tool, no memory, no history. Whose voice it was only the panel itself sets, never the request. 4. The switch reads the question: Fixed rules put the own latest message into a group. A new own request that does not point back at the answer from outside text leaves

head: Way
title: Way
text: that answer and its lock out. If no rule knows the question, the model may pick once from a fixed list in parallel (when the admin has that on). A follow-up like „And tomorrow?“ takes the group of the own question before (intent.follow_up); hint words add their groups, also beside the model's pick. A photo with a wish to change it (bilder.wants_change) is the group pictures, without the model's pick. 5. Build the system prompt: The admin's system prompt, plus the profile's length and style and a note per channel (watch, Siri, speaker, phone, Telegram, app, browser). With „Fast answer start“ what holds for this turn only goes with the question instead of the system prompt, so the server reads it from its cache. With „Trim a large memory“ a long memory keeps only the newest facts fixed in it (at most 6000 characters), plus up to 5 older ones that share words with the question, for this turn only (chat.memory_split). When the knowledge book is on and has pages, up to 40 page titles that fit the question best come along, as outside text (wissensbuch.hint). 6. Fixed sentence?: Sentences like „Spark Notaus“, „report a problem: …“ or „that was wrong“ the panel carries out itself, only fr

head: Way
title: Way
text: om the profile's own words and never over MCP. The model only says the result and gets no tool in this turn. 7. Answer to a question back?: If the panel asked which device is meant, a button, a number or the name counts as the answer, only in the same conversation, from the own profile and within 2 minutes. „None of these“ brings the whole list, „No, the other one“ corrects the last choice. The panel carries out the choice and offers to remember it; a „yes“ to that counts for 15 minutes. 8. Kill switch or my kill switch?: From kill switch stage 2 or with the profile's own kill switch every waiting proposal is dropped; no „yes“ carries anything out. Reading and answering go on. 9. Yes to a proposal: If a proposal of this conversation waits (an appointment, a mail change, a list entry, a correction, a call, an answer for the reMarkable), the panel decides on the „yes“. One yes confirms exactly one thing; every answer settles all other waiting proposals of this conversation. 10. Tools by rights: Each tool group comes only with the admin's switch, the release for the profile and its own data: search, memory, history, documents, smart home, reminders, calendar, mail. Telegram, the iPhon

head: Way
title: Way
text: e app and CarPlay can only make it narrower, never wider. Another recognized voice at this device gets nothing personal. A message that only asks („Do you know my brother's name?“: one sentence with a question mark, nothing to remember) gets no memory_save (chat.offer_memory), so no made-up fact is saved. 11. Something takes tools away?: The kill switch takes away tools to the internet or that change things, „Ask Spark“ over MCP keeps only the connection's tools, a picture, a fixed sentence or a fixed panel path (calls by the assistant, rufen.py) leaves none. For a guest the list is emptied once more, whatever filled it. 12. The switch narrows: With „Targeted tool choice“ only the question's group stays. Then the panel decides whether to search locally first (never for a plain „yes“ or „no“ and never when it already carried out something confirmed in this turn), whether it does a clear fetch itself and which tool the first round must call. With „Fast answer start“ a recognized group always gets the same list in the same order, so the server keeps one start per group in its cache; only an unclear question sees the full list. 13. Turn ready: The system prompt goes first, with the too

head: Way
title: Way
text: ls and the lock rule. The kill switch is read again for every tool call: triggered during an answer, it holds the next call off.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Guest asks for the weather: Answer without a tool: guests only get question and answer. · „The second“ after a question back: The panel switches the chosen device; the model only says the result. · Kill switch stage 2, asking for appointments: Only reading tools; adding appointments is not offered.

text: - 20000 characters at most per message (step 1) - 2 minutes a choice answers a question back (step 7) - 15 minutes „Shall I remember that?“ waits (step 7) - 4 buttons at most for a question back (step 7) - 2 kill switch stage without actions (step 8)

head: Settings
title: Settings
text: - People and devices → Blocked functions: what a single profile does not get. - Features → Ask instead of guessing: the panel asks instead of guessing (default off). - Features → Routing: the fixed rules that narrow the tools. - Features → Show steps and approvals: tools below the answer, a waiting proposal as a card with Yes and No and a question at the end of the answer with its answers as buttons (yes/no, A or B); a short yes to it keeps the topic of the question before (own profile and device only, default off).

head: What you see
title: What you see
text: - Logs → Requests: per question group, tools „x of y“, required tool and lock, without content. - Status → Logs: lines like „weiche: Absicht …“, „chat: web search …“, „chat: memory_save not offered …“ or „notaus: … Werkzeuge nicht angeboten“.

head: Switch
title: Switch
text: The switch puts the own latest message into a group (smart home, calendar, weather, mail and so on, today 23 groups) and so narrows the tools the language model sees in this turn. It works with fixed word lists; the model may at most pick once from a fixed list when no rule fits, and that too can only narrow.

head: Switch
title: Why
text: Why: Few fitting tools make the model faster and more accurate: it reads less and misses less often. Because the switch only takes away from what rights and locks left, a wrongly sorted sentence can never allow more, at most leave a tool out.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Only the own message: Only the person's own latest message is read, never an answer before, outside text or what the model wrote. The words the admin saved under Features → Routing are added. 2. Only small talk?: If the whole sentence is a greeting or thanks, the group is „plaudern“ (small talk). The answer then gets no tool at all. 3. Question about the Spark?: „How do I connect Home Assistant?“ or „Switch on web search“ ask about the Spark itself, not about a device or a search: group „spark“. A question about words or languages never counts, nor does „What can you tell me about the Frauenkirche?“: it asks about the thing, unless that is the Spark or one of its functions (hilfe.ABOUT). When „Ask Spark“ was used on a page of the panel, the same group holds by a fixed rule about where it was asked. 4. Words per group: Each group has its built-in word list (light, appointment, mailbox, umbrella …). A switching word without a device („all off“) only counts as a whole command. The admin's must words and own words per group (at most 20, whole words only) find a group as well, but replace nothing. 5. Priority between groups: When several groups match, fixed rules tidy up: weather, li

head: Way
title: Way
text: st, message, document and „create document“ come before smart home when there is no switching command; parcels before mail; „Do I have new messages?“ is a message, „What is in the news?“ the web search; a job that comes back regularly or watches something is an agent; a question about language, nature or a difference is never a device; a price or a strike is the web search, not the iPhone or the train; „Call me“ is the Spark calling back, not the iPhone; „a list of …“ in a file is not the own list. Last, the admin's „Not with“ words take groups out again. 6. Group recognized?: One group or at most 2 count as clear and narrow. More groups at once are not clear enough: then every tool stays. 7. Note hint words: If no rule recognizes a group for sure, the switch looks for weaker hint words: „water the plants“ points to the weather, „Friday“ to the calendar. A hint never narrows; it only makes sure its group's tools stay when something narrows later. 8. Follow-up?: If the message is short (at most 80 characters), points back („and“, „that“, „it“) and the own question just before had a clear group, that group holds again. Only the own question counts, never the answer. The journal says

head: Way
title: Way
text: „weiche: Folgefrage“. So does a plain „yes“/„no“ or a button of the question card to the question of the answer before (ablauf.was_asked, ten minutes, same conversation): „weiche: Antwort auf Rückfrage“. 9. Targeted tool choice on?: Only with this switch does the switch narrow, and not with a picture or a direct smart home command. Without it the group only goes to the journal and statistics; the model sees every tool the rights allow. 10. Model sorts?: If no rule found a group and „Questions no rule recognizes“ is set to the model, the language model picks one group from the fixed list once (JSON only, only the own message). The question already runs beside the preparation from its start; the wait is at most 4 seconds, with „Fast answer start“ only 300 ms after the preparation. With classification with probabilities the pick only counts from the threshold (default 80 %); with Features → Helper model → For routing it asks the small helper model first, and while that is loading or unsure the big one at once, with the same threshold. The hint groups stay beside the pick. During a maintenance pause of the language model it is not asked. 11. Narrow: With a clear group its tools stay, p

head: Way
title: Way
text: lus always 5 fixed ones (remembering something, own documents, PC), the hints' tools, the admin's extra tools for this group (at most 6) and what the own words name explicitly („onto the reMarkable“). All only as far as already offered. If nothing of the group is offered or the group is set to „do not narrow“, all stay. 12. Lean?: If the question stays without a group, the setting is „Lean“ and no must word requires a tool, the model only gets the short list: web search, Wikipedia, archive, earlier conversations, the fixed tools and the tools of the hint groups. It reads less and starts sooner. 13. Fix the first tool: One single clear group, one required tool and only that one of the group offered: the first round must call exactly that one („What will the weather be?“). A short, clear reading sentence („What is the weather today?“) is fetched by the panel itself with „Fetch clear questions directly“, for tomorrow and the day after with the date the panel works out. 14. Journal and count: Every turn writes a line „weiche: Absicht … | Grund … | Hinweis … | Werkzeuge x von y | Pflicht … | gesperrt … | eingrenzen an/aus“; a reason word only shows when it is still in the message. Per d

head: Way
title: Way
text: ay and group only counts are kept (8 days), never a word of the question. With „Keep unclear questions anonymously“ an unclear question of a profile (never a guest, never with the code word) also goes redacted onto the switch page: fixed rules as in „Report a problem“, contact names and every number become placeholders, a second check drops what still looks personal (weiche_unklar.anon); without profile, device and time, sealed, at most 100 sentences, 7 days. Then the list goes to the answer.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: „Turn off the living room light“: Group smarthome (word „Licht“): the model only sees the smart home tools and the fixed ones. · „And tomorrow?“ after a weather question: No rule fits, but the follow-up takes „wetter“: only the weather tool is required. · „Do I need to water the plants?“ with „Lean“: Unclear, hint „gießen“ → weather: short list plus the weather tool. · „Thanks!“: Group small talk: answer without a tool.

head: Everyday score
title: Everyday score
text: - The test sentences (172) hold every reported wrong turn and must all pass. The everyday sentences (216) were never used for tuning: they measure how many land right, are protected by a hint, stay open or land wrong. A self-test forbids right plus protected going down or wrong going up.

head: Tool names
title: Tool names
text: - Wherever a tool shows, a readable name comes from one table (92 tools), for example „Mailbox overview“ instead of mail_tidy_overview.

head: Settings
title: Settings
text: - Features → Targeted tool choice: without this switch the switch narrows nothing (default off). - Features → Routing: own words per group, „Not with“, extra tools, groups without narrowing, must words, own test sentences and what questions no rule recognizes get. Every change runs through all test sentences first; if one changes, it is saved only after confirming. Undo keeps the last 20 versions. - Features → Fetch clear questions directly: the panel fetches short reading questions itself (default off). - Features → Tune the switch (default off): the language model proposes words per group, the panel keeps a word only when no test sentence flips, the practice half gets better and the check half no worse; it is saved only with "Apply". - Features → Targeted tool choice → Keep unclear questions anonymously (default off): the profiles' unclear questions show redacted at „unclear“ on the switch, with „Belongs to …“ for tuning; every profile can switch it off for itself under Me → Conversation → Privacy.

head: Build answer
title: Build answer
text: This is where the answer is made: the panel asks the language model in rounds, runs offered tools, checks every finished sentence by fixed rules and sends text and sound to the device as one stream. The panel decides the checks, never the model.

head: Build answer
title: Why
text: Why: A language model likes to make up times, amounts or deeds („the light is on“) that never happened. Spoken, that sounds like a fact. So the panel only says sentences that fit what was really read or done, and still starts speaking quickly.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Question arrives: chat() checks the rate limit, sets the mark „speech is running“ (background work waits) and shows the profile's other devices „answering“. Then chat_turn.prepare works out rights, locks, system prompt and the offered tools; _answer takes over. When the language model pauses (maintenance pause, emergency mode), a fixed sentence comes at once; in emergency mode with Parakeet the fixed commands come first, without a model (notbetrieb.antwort: Home Assistant, time, reminders). With „Answer simple things at once“ the time, the date, calculations (rechnen.calc), date calculations and units as a whole short sentence get the panel's fixed sentence, without a model and without an instant sentence before it (sofort.answer, at most 80 characters). 2. Open the stream, instant sentence: Two queues connect everything: one for events to the device, one for sentences to speech output. When the instant acknowledgement is allowed, a recorded sentence plays at once (no GPU); if the answer then stays silent, one bridge sentence follows. 3. What the panel does itself: When the preparation decided that the panel acts itself (a switch command, reading states, „search locally first“,

head: Way
title: Way
text: a clear reading request), it runs now. The result goes to the model like a tool result, outside text wrapped as data. An article from the own Kiwix then stands as a source under the answer, with its book and the book's date. 4. Prepare a round: Offered is the list without locked tools, tools stopped after errors or used too often. When the question needs a tool, the model must choose one (tool_choice), with its own temperature. The fifth round has no list: the model is told to answer now. Devices without a screen (speaker, phone, watch, Siri, Android assistant, CarPlay) get at most 700 tokens; a longer answer ends at its last full sentence. 5. Stream and cut into sentences: The answer comes piece by piece. Thinking and tool calls written as text are never shown or spoken. split_sentences cuts finished sentences off („z. B.“ and „5. Oktober“ are no sentence end); a long first sentence goes at a comma, so the first sound comes early. 6. Figure without proof?: For data questions answercheck compares every time, date, score and amount in the sentence with everything the model was given. After a calendar read only figures from this answer count, not from earlier ones; a quoted appointme

head: Way
title: Way
text: nt title must be in the result. With „Extended answer check“ also temperatures, km and percentages (rounded counts, answercheck.MORE_SLACK) and every quoted name in every data answer. With „Exact calculations“ rechnen.fix first computes every calculation in the sentence again, number words too („17 times 23 is 381“, „six times six is 35“) and puts in the panel's result; its results count as proven here (answercheck.calc_facts). While that is on, every sentence comes only when it is complete. 7. Deed without a tool?: When a sentence claims a deed („is on now“, „entered it“), a tool of that kind must have worked in this answer (taten.check). A sentence that only announces a tool call or a deed („I'm calling the timer tool …“) is never said; when no tool follows, the panel says its fixed sentence at the end (taten.announces). When a tool of the claimed kind works later in the same answer („I'm making the song.“ before musik_machen), the sentence is left out silently. Applies when a changing tool or none at all was offered. 8. Show and speak: A checked sentence goes to the device as text and into the speech output queue; code blocks are only shown. A sentence already said in an earlier

head: Way
title: Way
text: round is left out. After the first sentence speech output joins everything waiting into one piece, so the voice stays calm. 9. Data question without looking?: When the question needs a tool and the model answers without one, the whole round is never said. The model is asked once more, told to use the tool first. 10. Tool wanted?: When the model wrote no tool call or hit the length limit, the answer is done. At the length limit it is spoken up to the last sentence end, the rest is dropped. 11. Run the tools: Half words before the call are taken back, a finished sentence stays. Every call goes through chat_tools.run; the result comes back as a tool message. A tool that fails twice the same way is stopped for this answer. When no rule recognized the question, the switch counts the group of the first tool and the fixed hint word (weiche.learn), never a word of the question. Reading tools (calendar, weather, parcels) take their data from their service's memory while it is fresh enough (Vorrat je Profil, vorrat.take); an older reading waits at most 2.0 s for the server and otherwise comes with its time and day („as of yesterday 18:00“, frisch.stand), „look again“ always asks the server.

head: Way
title: Way
text: Every answer keeps how long the tools waited and where each service came from (latency, Status → Checks). 12. Honest closing sentences: When a sentence fell out because of a figure, the panel says „I have no more precise details on that.“; when a deed fell out, a fixed sentence from taten.sentence. When a service came only with an older reading, a search for today found nothing of today or an archive article comes from a Kiwix book older than a year, and the answer does not say so itself, the panel adds „Not quite current: weather: as of yesterday 23:10.“ (frisch.nachsatz, rule „name the stand“ of the answer check). All of them come from the panel, never from the model. When the language model does not answer because it is switching, restarting or being measured, the panel says so with the expected time (llmstart.satz, also during a switch's maintenance pause). 13. The panel's own questions: Only when nothing from outside was read: offer to remember a learned correction or ask about a fact in memory (by fixed rules). Then the panel puts the answer on the reMarkable when asked; when the answer itself offers to go there, it waits for a „yes“ (remarkable.propose). It fetches ahead fo

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Small talk without a tool: Spoken from the first sentence, no check steps in. · Tomorrow's appointments: The model calls the calendar, the next round answers from the result. · Made-up time: The sentence with the time is never said, an honest sentence instead. · „Light is on“, switching failed: Instead of the claim: „That did not work: …“.

text: - 4 tool calls per round, more do not run (step 11) - 3 memory notes per answer (step 11) - 2.0 s a tool waits at most for the server when an older reading is at hand (step 11) - 2 same failures until a tool stops (or 3 of any kind) (step 11) - 50 characters after which the first sentence goes at a comma (step 5)

head: Settings
title: Settings
text: - Settings → Language model: Answer check, Check deeds and Stop error loops (all three on by default). - Settings → Language model: Length of an answer, Temperature, Think first; under Advanced the Web searches per answer.

text: - Status → Logs → Requests: every round, every tool, „answer check“ and „check deeds“ with numbers, never with text. - Status → Logs → Advanced → Conversation: where the time of an answer went, up to the first sound. - Status → Improve: how often the built-in rules stepped in today. - Below the answer (Features → Show steps and approvals): every tool with ✓/⚠ and time, a waiting proposal as a card with Yes and No, else a question at the end with its answers as buttons (ablauf.asks); only names and numbers, never results.

head: Tools
title: Tools
text: When the model calls a tool, chat_tools.run carries it out, but only when it was offered in this round and no lock applies. The result goes back to the model as data, never as a command.

head: Tools
title: Why
text: Why: A server parser passes through any tool name the model writes, also made-up or locked ones. And a web page or mail could ask the model to switch the light or send data away. So the panel checks every call again instead of trusting the model.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. The model calls a tool: At most 4 calls per round run, and a tool stopped after errors does not run again. Memory notes are limited to 3 per answer. 2. Offered in this round?: Only tools on this round's list run. The list is already cut by the locks; anything else gets „not available, do not call it again“ or, after a mail, the reason of the mail lock. 3. Kill switch holds it?: The kill switch is read for every call, so it also applies in the middle of an answer. From stage 1 the tools that go to the internet by themselves are locked; from stage 2 or with the profile's own kill switch every tool that changes something. 4. Outside text read?: When this answer already read text from outside, nothing may change the home, the memory, appointments or reminders any more. After a mail everything that asks the internet is closed too (web search, Wikipedia, weather, transit), after own documents the web search (except with „search locally first“, then only with the question's own words). A song the person asks for stays open after outside text (own), not after mail. 5. Service gone right now?: When the service watch sees this tool's service down (and its switch is on), a fixed sentence w

head: Way
title: Way
text: ith the time of the outage comes at once instead of a try. Web search checks further down and then can fall back to the own archive. 6. Mark reading: Tools that bring outside text (web search, documents, calendar, earlier conversations, camera) set the mark before they run. From then on the locks of step 4 hold for the rest of the answer. With the knowledge book document_search brings the fitting page first, then the passages; both are outside text. A passage without the words asked for drops out (lokal.cover); if none is left, the fixed sentence chat_tools.NOTHING_FITS comes instead of unrelated passages. 7. Run the tool: Extensions get profile, device and origin from the panel, never from the model. Smart home changes need the code word in the latest message when one is set. Connections to outside services go through the guard. Home Assistant reads states from the live connection's copy (halive.states) while it stands for exactly this address and key, else over HTTP. The period of the web search comes from the question's own words and the query (frisch.zeitraum), never from the panel's time note. 8. Errors as a sentence: When a service cannot be reached, it becomes a short result

head: Way
title: Way
text: text („not reachable“, „search failed, do not guess“). An offered tool without a matching setup answers „unknown“. 9. Wrap the result as data: Outside text gets a fixed note in front and stands between markers it cannot close itself; the model's own markers („<|im_start|>“, „<tool_call>“) in it are defused (textnorm.defuse). Home Assistant states with free text (titles, lists, a state made of words) count as outside too. With „Faster web search“ the long note stands once per answer, before every further block a short one with the same rule (chat.OUTSIDE_AGAIN); the markers always stay. 10. Device marks the answer: The device learns that the answer rests on outside text. Such answers do not go to the model again later. 11. Record: The log line names the tool only when it was offered, else „unbekannt“. What was a deed is noted by taten for the action check. People see the readable names from werkzeuge.py. 12. Failed twice?: When a tool fails 2 times with the same details or 3 times at all, it is stopped for this answer and the model is told to say honestly what did not work. 13. Result back to the model: The model gets the result as data in the next round. What it says from it is ch

head: Knowledge
title: Knowledge
text: Knowledge is everything the Spark knows without going to the internet: the uploaded documents of each profile (one SQLite file wissen.db per profile), the memory, earlier conversations, the own Kiwix archive and created documents. This page shows the way a question finds fitting passages in the documents.

head: Knowledge
title: Why
text: Why: The language model does not know the own papers. It only gets the few passages the panel picks with fixed rules and two small models on the processor, each with its source. What a document says is outside text: data, never a command.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Model calls document_search: The tool is offered only when the profile has own or shared documents, the function is released for the profile and the voice is recognized. Guests and unknown voices at a shared speaker never get it. The profile comes from the login, never from the model. 2. Tags or kind allowed?: The model may narrow the search to tags or a kind of document (at most five tags). With „Document card and tags“ off for the profile these are dropped and every document is searched. 3. Meaning vector of the question: With meaning search a small vector model (own process, processor only) computes the question's vector. It starts only with at least 8.5 GiB free memory (on a panel computer 1.5 GiB) and ends after 10 minutes without work. Without a vector the Spark searches full text only, without an error. 4. Narrowed?: With tags or kind, match_docs first finds the documents that carry all tags and the kind. Only their passages stay in the race; if none fits, there are no hits. 5. Full text: words and context line: The question is split into search words (filler words dropped, endings roughly cut). The search looks in each passage's words and in its context line (title, kind

head: Way
title: Way
text: , headings), which counts only 0.4. The best 30 get a rank. 6. Mix in meaning: If the question has a vector, it is compared with every passage's vector. Below 0.75 similarity nothing counts as related; the best 30 above get a rank too. Both ranks are added, so a passage high in both lists rises. The vectors are kept in memory as float32 and read again only when passages or used documents change; while vectors are still missing, at most every 30 seconds. 7. Newest first?: With „Newest first“ a passage changed lately gets a small lead, about two places, which shrinks with age. Fit stays more important; each hit then carries its date. 8. Shared documents of the others: With „Shared documents“ the same search runs in the other profiles' files, but only over documents marked „for everyone“ there or shared singly with this profile through „Sharing with profiles“ (documents.Offer). With the household folder released for the profile it also runs in the household's store (users/haushalt/). The hits carry the owner's name or „Haushalt“; everything is sorted by rank. 9. Re-rank hits on?: Without re-ranking the first five of the mix go on. With re-ranking the mix hands over its best 30. 10. Cr

head: Way
title: Way
text: oss-encoder orders: A small model on the processor reads question and passage together and gives each a number. Passages below -4.0 do not answer the question and drop out, the best five stay. If the model sleeps, is busy, too slow or broken, the mix's order stays; the answer never waits longer than set. 11. „What did I note lately?“: If the person asks in their own words what they noted lately, today or this week, the pages changed last come first. If nothing changed in that time, the tool says so instead of guessing. 12. No passage found?: A passage only goes on when it holds at least 0.6 of the search words (filler words like „information“ or „archive“ do not count); a dealer list with only „Dresden“ is no answer about the Frauenkirche. If all drop out so, a fixed sentence says: nothing fitting, say so and look in the archive or on the web if offered. If the search finds nothing but tags or a kind were given, the model gets the card lines of the fitting documents. Otherwise: nothing found, say so, do not guess. 13. Passages with source to the model: Each passage goes to the model with document, page and section. From now on the answer counts as one that read outside text: switch

head: Way
title: Way
text: ing, saving to memory and reminders are locked in it. The device shows the sources.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Question about a contract clause: Found: the clause and two neighbouring passages, re-ranked, with page. · Vector model still asleep: Found by full text alone; the answer did not wait. · Invoices with a tag, words do not fit: No passage, but the list of documents with the tag.

head: Knowledge book
title: Knowledge book
text: - In quiet minutes the language model gets an own document in numbered passages and at most 5 existing pages the panel picks by words shared with title, sender and tags. The model proposes sentences as JSON, each with the number of its passage. - The panel keeps a sentence only when its passage exists, every number and date in it stands in the passage, it has at most 400 characters and holds neither link nor command. If it says the same as a sentence of the page with another number, both stay as a contradiction. One document changes at most 5 pages. - On a question document_search puts the best fitting pages before the passages, each sentence with its source. The pages are outside text like the documents. - At night (in the search check's window, once per profile) the panel checks by fixed rules: a document read again is worked in again, sentences of vanished documents go, gedaechtnis.check marks passed dates and old time words as „out of date?“. Then the model answers for up to 50 sentences only „does the passage say so?“; a no removes the sentence. Deleted or left-out documents take their sentences at once (documents.on_gone). - When an answer rests on at least 2 sources (documen

head: Knowledge book
title: Knowledge book
text: ts or Kiwix articles), the panel keeps it in memory for an hour; only the click „To the knowledge book“ files it as a page „Answer“. Every sentence needs a passage from these sources with all its numbers and enough shared words. Export as Obsidian folder (ZIP); at night a copy into the filing folder when the profile files automatically and the book changed.

head: Knowledge map
title: Knowledge map
text: - When the knowledge map is on, the language model gets the same document again after the knowledge book, with at most 12 pages the panel picks (the document's pages and pages whose title it names). The model proposes connections as JSON, each with a kind from a fixed list and the number of its passage. - The panel keeps a connection only when both pages were offered, both are named in the passage, every number of the detail stands in the passage and a cause (led to, causes, raises, lowers) has a word of reason in the passage. At most 30 per document; „Not right“ never brings the same connection back from the same document. - Browser and app draw the map with their own code from names and kinds, never from SVG, Mermaid or DOT of the model. The panel only answers the visible part with at most 150 points; the export as Mermaid or Graphviz text comes from fixed code with cleaned names.

head: Look locally first
title: Look locally first
text: - Before the first round the panel itself looks in documents, Kiwix and earlier conversations, at the same time and only briefly. Meaning search only rides along when its model already runs and is free; it is not woken for it. - A passage only counts when it holds at least 0.6 of the search words (a long word may be mistyped by one or two letters, lokal.same). What comes too late is not waited for. The Kiwix has its own time limit (default 900 ms, the other sources 400 ms) and asks at most 5 books per question: the biggest German Wikipedia and the books whose title or description fits the question (kiwix.pick). An archive article stands as a dated source under the answer. - From a passage of the documents the model gets at most 500 characters, namely the part with the search words, not the start (lokal.excerpt). From a table that is the head row and the rows with the rarest search words: a word in every row („card“) counts little, „diarrhoea“ in one row a lot; rows with less than half the weight of the best are not added.

head: Tables in PDFs
title: Tables in PDFs
text: - pypdf reads a table cell by cell, each cell on its own line; which card belongs to which complaint would be lost. pdftabellen.read therefore looks at every PDF page with pdfium: the drawn lines and boxes give the rows, vertical lines or gaps in the text the columns, and each cell gets the text from its own box. Each row becomes one line „| Diarrhoea | SR 18 … | Note |“. A page without a drawn table stays as pypdf read it. After 20 s per document the remaining pages stay so too. - A table up to 2400 characters stays one passage. A longer one is cut only between its rows (documents._rows), and every piece starts with its head row. - PDFs from before are looked at one by one in quiet minutes (documents.due_tables): if the original is kept and has a table, it is read again; otherwise it stays as it is. Without the original only uploading it again helps.

head: Memory
title: Memory
text: - The memory is not searched. The panel sorts the facts by fixed rules into three blocks (sure, learned, maybe out of date) and gives them to the model in the system prompt.

head: Guard
title: Guard
text: The guard decides for every connection a tool opens to the outside whether it may happen: web pages from search, calendars, contacts, mail, Home Assistant, NAS and MCP services. It checks the address that is really asked, by fixed rules; it never asks the language model.

head: Guard
title: Why
text: Why: Text from outside (a web page, a mail, a calendar entry) could lead the language model to ask addresses in the home network, cloud metadata or the Spark's own services (SSRF). The guard does not let that happen, whatever the text says.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A tool wants out: Everything that goes to an address from settings or from outside text gets its access through netguard.client with a level (today 33 modules). Fixed own services like the language model go directly; which ones and why is listed in netguard.DIRECT_OK, a self-test keeps that list complete. 2. Resolve the name once: resolve() looks the name up exactly once. If it has several addresses, each one must be allowed, else it stops. 3. Own service?: The ports of the own services are closed on this machine: on loopback and on every own address in the LAN or VPN (own_addresses reads them again every minute). When the models run on another computer (models.host), its addresses count the same (model_addresses). 4. Internet and kill switch on?: If the address is public and the kill switch is at stage 1 or higher, nothing goes to the internet, whatever level the tool has. The home network stays reachable as the level allows. 5. Public address?: A public address is allowed at every level. 6. Level „internet only“?: What comes from search results or answers may never go to the home network (chat, feeds, geraeteupdate, ghtoken, mailansicht, meldung, modellseite, remarkable, verbu

head: Way
title: Way
text: nd). 7. Never allowed?: Link-local addresses (169.254.x, where cloud metadata answers), multicast, unspecified and reserved addresses are allowed at no level. 8. Home network allowed?: Home Assistant and other services in the home network (doclingdienst, esp32, hamelden, homeassistant, kiwix, offsite) always may. Calendars, contacts, mail and MCP (calendars, contacts, mail, mcp, meinmcp, tasks) only when Settings → Security → Allow home network addresses is on. 9. Connect to exactly this address: The connection goes to the checked address, not to the name again. A second look-up could answer differently (DNS rebinding). The certificate is still checked for the name. 10. Password only to its own site: Login data only goes to the site it was entered for (same host or same parent domain, like the CalDAV servers of icloud.com), never over http when the address was https. 11. Answer at most 20 MB: Answers are cut at 20 MB, also after unpacking gzip, so a huge or packed answer cannot fill the memory. 12. Answer to the tool: The tool gets the answer as data. A redirect is a new connection and is checked the same way, from step 2.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Web page from search: Allowed: connected to the checked public address. · Home Assistant at home: Allowed: the level home may go to the home network. · Calendar at home, switch off: Blocked: home network addresses are off for user services. · Link to cloud metadata: Blocked: a page from search never goes home, 169.254 never. · Kill switch on, ask weather: Blocked: with the kill switch nothing goes to the internet.

head: When blocked
title: When blocked
text: - Instead of an answer the tool gets the error Blocked with the reason; no connection is made. - The block counts for „Emergency stop by itself“: 15 in 10 minutes raise the kill switch to stage 1 when the switch is on. Blocks by the kill switch itself and probes of the service watch do not count.

title: Numbers (from the code)
text: - 20 MB largest answer (step 11) - 30000–31099, 31443 closed own ports (step 3) - 15 blocks in 10 minutes until kill switch stage 1 (if on) (step 4) - 1 kill switch stage without internet (step 4)

head: Settings
title: Settings
text: - Settings → Security → Allow home network addresses: calendars, contacts, mail and MCP may also go to the home network (default off). - Settings → Security → Emergency stop by itself: many blocked connections in a short time trigger kill switch stage 1 (default off).

head: What you see
title: What you see
text: - Status → Live: a red line ends with ✕ at the wall, with address and reason; the tile „Wächter today“ counts the blocks. - Me → My status: whether an own service (calendar, mail) answers or refused the login.

head: Logs and live
title: Logs and live
text: Operation records what the Spark does, without contents: the way of each request (Logs → Requests), the live overview, the journal with fixed words, the service watch and the backup. This page shows which traces a request leaves.

head: Logs and live
title: Why
text: Why: Whoever looks for a fault must see which way a request took and how long each step lasted. Questions, answers and tool results belong to the person; so only fixed words, tool names and numbers go into the log and the history.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A request comes in: Chat, writing help, creating documents and what the Spark does by itself create a record at the start: channel, kind (profile, guest, admin, Spark) and device. Before any switch aktiv.py counts the request for „Aktiv 10 min“ (OLED, Monitoring, Live): a profile once, a guest per device as a shortened hash, nothing of the Spark itself, in memory only. 2. Anything switched on?: If neither „Trace requests“ nor the live page nor the settings assistant is on, there is no record. Only the modules' journal lines remain. 3. Steps with fixed words: Each step (switch, model round, tool, check, speech output) is added with kind, name and time. A value goes in only if it is a number or a short fixed word; anything else is dropped. Question, answer, arguments and results never go in. 4. Live page on?: With the live page on, live.py sees each step at once: which service is asked, what the guard decides, what comes back. Everything stays in memory and is gone after a restart. 5. Journal lines of the modules: Independently each module writes its lines into the Spark's journal. Every line starts with a word from logfilter.AREAS (35 areas), profiles only through profiles.log_na

head: Way
title: Way
text: me. A self-test checks both. 6. End and verdict: At the end the record gets its state: error if an error word is set, slow if the first sound came later than 5.0 s, else good. 7. Trace requests on?: If only Live or the settings assistant is on, the record ends here. It is written nowhere. 8. Line „anfrage:“ into the journal: One line per request: id, channel, class, tools with ok or not ok, time to the instant reply, to the first sound and to the end. Without names. 9. Request history on disk: The record is appended. When the file grows too big, only the last 500 requests of the last 2880 minutes stay. The file is in no backup. 10. Admin reads Logs → Requests: Only the admin and co-admins read the history, with a rate limit. A profile's name and device show only when the profile allows it; else it says „Profil“. For one request the panel shows the journal lines from its time. 11. Read and sort the journal: logfilter reads at most 20000 lines; only numbers from fixed lists reach journalctl. Each line gets its area from its first word, its level from fixed error words; tokens, keys and passwords are blacked out before the line leaves the panel. 12. Diagnosis with a fixed hint: The di

head: Way
title: Way
text: agnosis counts lines per area and shows a fixed hint from a list for the newest error, never one from the model.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: All on, a question with a tool: Live shows the way, Logs → Requests keeps it, the journal has the line „anfrage:“. · Only the live page on: Visible on Status → Live, then stored nowhere. · Everything off: No record; only the modules' journal lines.

head: Service watch
title: Service watch
text: - A loop looks at the language model, listening, speaking, internet, SearXNG, Kiwix, Home Assistant, mail, calendar and NAS, each every minute or every 5 minutes, without login: an HTTP answer below 500 counts as „answers“. Home Assistant is asked for /manifest.json, which it answers without a token; /api/ without a token counted there as a failed login. - A service is gone after 3 failed probes over at least 3 minutes, back after 2 good ones. With the internet gone there is one note for everything behind it. During update, start and kill switch stage 2 nothing counts, nor for a part in the maintenance pause until its time is up. - The probes go through the guard but do not count on the live list and never trigger the automatic kill switch.

head: Backup
title: Backup
text: - Once a day in a pause the panel packs users/, voices/, config.json, the panel password and the files of backup.STATE_FILES. The key state/secret.key and the login keys are not in it; databases are saved as a consistent copy.

head: Numbers (from the code)
title: Numbers (from the code)
text: - 500 requests in the history at most (step 9) - 2880 min so long a request stays (step 9) - 5.0 s from here a request counts as slow (step 6) - 3 failed probes in a row until a service counts as gone (step 5) - 30 min at most one outage note per service (step 5) - 7 daily and manual backups kept (step 9)

text: - Settings → Spark → Operation → Trace requests: Logs → Requests (default off). - Settings → Spark → Operation → Logs “Live page”: Status → Live (default off). - Features → Service watch: look at services and tell the admins about outages (default off). - Features → Maintenance pause: pause the language model, speech recognition or speech output before an update (default off), then Status → Maintenance pause. - Settings → Backup: create a backup by hand or restore one.

head: Language model
title: Language model
text: The language model writes the answers: the own one behind the LLM-Tor or qwen38 from dgx-spark-qwen38 (not part of this repo). The panel talks to it at the configured address through the OpenAI interface, streamed, and makes sure speech always comes before background work. Address, key and model name live only in llm.py; every background job asks through llm.complete. With Features → Helper model → For short texts the small helper model writes the jobs in llm.HELFER_JOBS first, else the big one at once.

head: Language model
title: Why
text: Why: The GPU is shared between the model and speech output. While a person waits, no learning or tidying in the background may slow the answer. And a hanging or missing model should give a clear sentence, not minutes of silence.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Speech first: When an answer starts and with every streamed piece the panel sets the mark „speech is running“. Background work on the model waits until 20 seconds after it and is cancelled as soon as somebody speaks; after 3 cancels it gives up for this time. 2. Maintenance pause?: When an admin paused the language model for an update, the panel does not ask it at all: the answer is a fixed sentence with the time left at once, the Weiche and System One do not ask either. Background work on the model waits until the pause ends and does not count that as a cancel. At the end of the time the pause only ends once the model answers 2 times in a row. With “Automatically on restart” the panel pauses by itself as soon as a language model service (own or qwen38) restarts or switches (at most 30 min) and goes on once the model answers again. When the model runs on another computer that does not answer (emergency mode, steuer.weg), the same holds with the sentence “The Spark is taking a break right now.”; the Dienst-Wächter still reports the outage. With Features → Emergency mode with Parakeet, Parakeet on the panel computer then hears, and fixed commands (Home Assistant, time, reminders)

head: Way
title: Way
text: work without a model (notbetrieb.antwort). 3. Connection for this answer: Every answer has its own connection with the configured time limit (a value outside does not count) and five seconds to connect. When a key is set, it goes along as Bearer. The model is a fixed own service and does not go through the guard. 4. Model name: When no model is configured, the panel asks /models once and keeps the first name for this address. 5. Build the request: The request streams, with length, temperature, top_p, top_k and presence_penalty from the settings (0 = the server's default; the quality test compares with Qwen's recommendation). Thinking is off unless „Think first“ is on. While a tool is chosen its own temperature applies. The server always reports at the end how much it read and wrote and how much came from its cache. 6. Someone with priority waiting?: When another person has priority and their answer has no first sentence yet, this round waits at most the configured time (up to 5 seconds). An answer with priority holds others up for at most 30 seconds. Before that the quota (day, week, month) is checked: a profile over it gets a fixed sentence instead of an answer, fixed commands wit

head: Way
title: Way
text: hout a model still work. 7. One round to the model: The round goes to the configured address. When the server refuses the forced tool choice, the same round goes once without it. 8. Too long for the model?: When the server says the request is longer than its context, the panel cuts the history to a quarter of the history budget in the first round and asks once more. 9. First line in time?: The first line must come within 90 seconds (or the shorter time limit). A model that stays silent longer hangs: the answer ends with a clear sentence instead of minutes of silence. 10. Read the lines: Every line is a piece of JSON. Tool calls come in parts and are put together by their number; thinking the server hands over separately is only counted. Unreadable lines are skipped. 11. Only answer text goes on: Thinking inside the text (<think> … </think>) and tool calls that come as text are never shown or spoken. The rest goes piece by piece to „build answer“. 12. Record the round: For the request trace only numbers count: tokens read, of them from the cache, size of system prompt, tool list and history, time to the first word, waiting time for priority. The usage counter counts tokens read and

head: Way
title: Way
text: written per task and profile (estimated without the server's report, about 3.5 characters per token). 13. Error on the way?: An error becomes a fixed code: not reachable, too slow, key refused, model missing. With „not reachable“ and „too slow“ a fixed sentence is also spoken when nothing was said yet. Guests see only the kind of error, never its text. 14. Text and tool calls back: The round returns why it ended and which tools the model wants to call. The panel decides what of it runs.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Normal answer: Streamed, the first sentence goes to speech output at once. · Two people, one with priority: The round waits briefly until the answer with priority has its first sentence. · Very long document in the history: History cut, asked once more. · Language model hangs: „My language model is not answering right now.“ instead of silence. · Language model is being updated: „I am being updated right now and will be back in about 20 minutes.“

head: Speech recognition
title: Speech recognition
text: Speech recognition turns a recording into text. The panel takes the recording, checks it and hands it to the ASR service. That proxy checks key, size and sample rate, lets requests wait by priority and passes them to the engine, which listens on this machine only.

head: Speech recognition
title: Why
text: Why: A recording comes from outside: a browser, an app, a speaker. It could be huge, carry a made-up sample rate or be only silence, a click or the Spark's own voice. Fixed rules catch that before the GPU works and before a text counts as a question.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A recording arrives: The browser sends the recording to the panel. Each caller may only so often per minute (profile 240), guests share 3 places at once. 2. At most 50 MB: read_audio reads the recording in pieces and stops at 50 MB. Only a signed-in profile may send a wake word; it then goes to the model as a hint. With „Names for listening“ hoerwoerter.prompt adds the names of the profiles and the profile's contacts, rooms and devices (at most 100, shared speakers only profile names). While the profile plays the Dungeon Master in the car, the round's names come first (dungeon_auto.words), never anything from its hidden truth. 3. Alongside on the CPU: While the GPU recognizes, the CPU already runs speaker identification (when on and a profile asks), the room voice, the check for an unknown voice and the measure of how much of the recording is really voice. At a speaking pause with „Turn end by tone“ satzende.start also asks Smart Turn on the model computer (asr_proxy.turn), only for a number to measure. 4. To the ASR service: The panel sends the recording with the API key to the proxy. stufe.asr_level adds the profile's stage, but not at a shared speaker. Only the panel can set

head: Way
title: Way
text: a stage: with the key from vorrang-key and only from this machine, else it is normal. 5. Key and size fine?: BodyLimit refuses requests that are too large or lack the right key before anything is read. Without a key set, only this machine itself may ask. 6. Engine ready?: engine_status asks the engine's /health. If it does not answer, the proxy reads its state and that of the systemd unit and names the reason. 7. Wait by priority: PrioGate lets as many recordings through as the engine takes at once (engine_max_seqs). The others wait by stage, then by arrival. Whoever waits moves up a stage every four seconds; a running request is never stopped. 8. Sample rate allowed?: audio_rate_ok reads the sample rate from the file's header (WAV, FLAC, Ogg, WebM) or asks ffprobe. A header with a made-up rate would fill the memory when it is converted. 9. Recognize: With Qwen3-ASR the recording goes to the vLLM engine, which listens on this machine only; only prompt, temperature and stream pass through, plus the context words from the settings. With Parakeet the proxy recognizes itself on the CPU, in pieces of at most 90 seconds cut at a quiet spot. In emergency mode with Parakeet (panel computer

head: Way
title: Way
text: , model computer gone) common.model_url takes the recording to speech-spark-notasr on port 31009, only for the computer itself: the same proxy with Parakeet, loaded at the first recording, unloaded after 10 minutes without one. 10. Silence, filler or echo?: stille.check drops text from almost silent recordings and a lone „Yes“ or „Okay“ with too little voice. For profiles echo.check looks whether the text is the Spark's own voice from another device, and fremdstimme whether a microphone that opened by itself heard an unknown voice. 11. Voice recognized?: speakers.identify compares the recording with every taught voiceprint. Only a clear match (above the threshold of the chosen strictness and clearly ahead of the runner-up) counts. Live shows only „voice recognized“, never whose. 12. Text back: The text goes to the device, which turns it into the question to the chat. On an error a guest gets only a fixed code, never the service's text.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Question in the browser, profile: Text back with the recognized voice. · Click after the answer: Dropped: too little voice, no question. · File with a made-up sample rate: Refused before the engine sees it. · Engine still loading: Refused with the reason, the device says so.

head: Speech output
title: Speech output
text: Speech output turns text into sound. The TTS service takes a sentence, tidies it, hides secrets, picks language and voice and passes it to the engine (Qwen3-TTS via vllm-omni), which listens on this machine only. The sound comes back streamed.

head: Speech output
title: Why
text: Why: A speaker in the room says out loud whatever it gets. Passwords and codes must never be spoken there, and signs like asterisks, links or emojis sound wrong. So fixed rules run on every sentence, wherever it comes from: chat, speaker, Telegram, reminders.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A sentence to speak: The panel sends every sentence of an answer with the API key and the profile's stage to the TTS service. Other programs may do so too with the API key. 2. Key and size fine?: BodyLimit refuses requests that are too large or lack the right key before anything is read. 3. Text valid?: The text must not be empty and may have at most 20000 characters. check_reference takes a reference voice only as an embedded data:audio address, never as a link: the engine would otherwise fetch a link itself from the home network. 4. Engine ready?: A VoiceDesign request goes to the second engine when it is on; everything else to the main engine. engine_status asks its /health and otherwise names the reason. 5. Markdown off, secrets hidden: speech_markdown takes out the formatting signs, then hide_secrets replaces passwords, code words, one-time codes and keys with „shown in writing only“. This runs on every request, also when „Clean text“ is off; the written answer keeps the value. 6. Clean the text: clean_text takes out emojis, „haha“, *laughs*, code blocks and links, calms exclamations if wanted and puts a full stop at the end of a line so the voice settles. If nothing is lef

head: Way
title: Way
text: t, no request goes to the engine. 7. Language, pronunciation, numbers: When the language is Auto, guess_language guesses German or English from frequent words, so a single English word does not change the tone of the whole answer. Then the own pronunciation list applies, after that speak_abbreviations writes out abbreviations („z. B.“, „ca.“, „€/Monat“) and speak_numbers date, time, money, numbers and units (km/h, kWh, kg, GB …). 8. Pick the voice: Temperature, top_p and a fixed seed from the settings keep the voice the same from sentence to sentence. A Base model speaks with a cloned voice from voices/ (apply_clone); an unknown name falls back to the default voice. With „Shorten the reference of your own voice“ (tts.ref_max_s) it takes a piece of a long recording instead: kurzref.cut_at cuts once at the quietest point before the limit, speech recognition writes the piece down, kurzref.keep_words keeps the words of the own text (at least 70 % alike, else the whole recording stays). Until the piece is ready, the whole recording applies. 9. Streamed at another tempo?: vllm-omni takes no tempo when streaming. Then tempo.Stretcher stretches the sound piece by piece itself (WSOLA, the p

head: Way
title: Way
text: itch stays). 10. Wait by priority: PrioGate lets as many sentences through as the engine takes at once (engine_max_seqs); the others wait by stage, then by arrival. 11. The engine speaks: The engine makes the sound. Streamed it comes back in pieces; the first piece is small on purpose (initial_chunk_frames) so the sound starts fast, also when several requests run. „Several voices at once“ (tts.engine_decode_batch) batches up to 2 or 4 voices in the decoder with CUDA graphs, „Remember the same beginning“ (tts.engine_prefix_cache) lets the engine reuse the same beginning of a voice's sentences; both are off (vllm-omni's default). 12. Sound back: The proxy passes the sound on unchanged and counts only time, length and errors for monitoring, never the text.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Answer sentence in the chat: Spoken, streamed, with a steady voice. · Password in the answer: The voice says „shown in writing only“, the written answer keeps the value. · Only an emoji: Nothing to say, nothing goes to the engine. · Speak faster: The proxy stretches the streamed sound.

title: Settings
text: - Settings → Speech output: model, default voice, language, clean text, reading numbers and the own pronunciation list. - Settings → Voices: record, play and save own voices (for a Base model). - Settings → Speech output → Advanced: „Shorten the reference of your own voice“, „Several voices at once“ and „Remember the same beginning“ (all off); before and after Status → Checks → Measure performance.
