head: Pictures and music
title: Pictures and music
text: Painting pictures turns a wish into a picture, on the Spark itself. The panel checks the wish with fixed rules and hands it to the picture service, which listens on this machine only. It loads FLUX.2 klein only at the first picture, checks the finished picture and frees the memory after a quiet time.

head: Pictures and music
title: Pictures and music
text: Making music works the same way next to it: a wish under Me → Music or musik_machen in the conversation becomes a song (instrumental and 2 minutes unless asked). The music service on :31004 loads ACE-Step 1.5 only for a song, in the model the admin picked, and frees the memory after a quiet time; "Test music" measures every installed model. Both services share the on-demand engine of bedarf.py. Editing music turns an own song into a new version (part anew, extend, genre, remix, new lyrics) with the same model; cutting, tempo and key the music service does at once with ffmpeg, without a model. Own files only with the rights tick.

head: Pictures and music
title: Pictures and music
text: Only one of the two models is loaded at a time (Dominik 2026-10-18): pictures and songs stand in one queue in the panel (schwer.py); who waits behind others hears the place and about how long it takes.

head: Pictures and music
title: Why
text: Why: A picture model can paint anything, also nudity, violence or real people. The language model never decides that; fixed rules before and after painting do. And the model needs a lot of shared memory: it must never push out the language model or the voice.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A picture wish: A profile writes a wish under Me → Pictures, or the router group "bild" offers the tool bild_malen in the conversation; the model writes an English prompt for it. Changing pictures starts without a tool: bilder.from_turn takes by a fixed rule the photo of this message or the result of the last change, under Me → Pictures an own picture. Everything ends in bilder.start. Quick buttons (rotate, brighter, black and white …) need no model: bilder.quick_png does them at once on the panel. A song wish comes the same way through Me → Music or the group "musik" with musik_machen into musik.start; a change of an own song through Me → Music or musik_bearbeiten into musik.start_edit (the panel picks the song, never the model), cutting and tempo without a model into musik.tone, an own file with the rights tick into musik.upload. 2. Feature released?: features.allowed asks the release: the admin switched painting pictures on and did not block this profile. Guests never get the tool; after outside text and at kill switch stage 2 it is locked. 3. Wish allowed?: bilder.refuse_text checks wish and prompt against a fixed word list (nothing sexual, no violence, no hate symbols) and

head: Way
title: Way
text: against the names of profiles and contacts. For songs musik.refuse_text checks wish, description and lyrics against the word list and secrets, wish and description for "in the style of" an artist (in the conversation with a fixed hint to send the description again without names); names are fine. "Write lyrics" (musik.write_lyrics) has the language model write the lyrics from the description and turn artist names into style words; the panel cuts "in the style of …" out and refuses if a name stays. The model cannot get around it. 4. Within the limits?: Per profile there are pictures per day (rolling 24 hours), space and at most 300 pictures; songs: songs per day, space and the longest song (musik.start), at most 10 versions per song, 10 own files a day; musik.plan_edit checks every number of a change. Admin profiles have no daily limits (coadmin.unbegrenzt); space and the queue hold for them too. On the whole Spark at most 10 heavy jobs wait, pictures and songs together. 5. Wait for a pause and the place: The job runs in the background (bilder._work, musik._work): it waits until nobody speaks (vorrang) and joins the one queue for pictures and songs (schwer.run). The fixed rule schwer

head: Way
title: Way
text: .pick takes the oldest; while the loaded kind still waits it goes first, but at most 3 times in a row while the other kind waits. When another kind is next, the panel first ends the loaded model. Who stands behind others gets a fixed sentence with the place and about how long (schwer.hint), the card shows "Waiting · place 2 of 3". A picture may take at most 720 seconds. 6. Model loaded?: bild_server.Engine.start first takes the one place (bedarf.OnDemand.claim, lock bedarf.lock: when the music service holds it, it answers "belegt") and starts sd-server as its own process on 127.0.0.1, but only when enough shared memory is free; otherwise everything else stays undisturbed. Too little memory does not end the job: it keeps its place and tries again every 30 seconds, for at most 600 seconds. 7. Paint: The engine paints the picture in 4 steps at the chosen size; its own output never reaches the journal, because it would name the prompt. 8. Picture harmless?: bild_server.nsfw_share lets a classifier on the CPU check the picture. Above 0.5 it is discarded; without the check the panel shows nothing. 9. Mark as AI picture: bild_server.finish re-encodes the picture as PNG and writes into it

head: Way
title: Way
text: that it is AI-made, a changed picture AI-edited (also as an IPTC entry). 10. Picture stored: The picture goes into the profile's folder with its job (bilder.keep), the card in the chat and in the iPhone app shows it, also in a conversation opened again; a push goes out through the app or Telegram. After a quiet time the picture service stops the engine and frees the memory. A song is kept as MP3 under users/ID/musik/ (musik.keep), with a player in the chat and under Me → Music.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Cat on a skateboard: Painted, marked, in the gallery. · Picture of the own profile name: Fixed refusal, the model is not asked. · Too little memory free: Nothing loaded, speech keeps running.

head: Services at home
title: Services at home
text: Services at home are what the Spark asks in the own network: Home Assistant, NAS, Kiwix, SearXNG and MCP services, on request also calendars, contacts and mail. Addresses from settings go through the guard (netguard) with a fixed level; fixed services like SearXNG go directly. The way of a tool call is the same as for the internet services (own box).

head: Services at home
title: Why
text: Why: A tool call comes from the model, and the model can be steered by outside text. So the panel checks by fixed rules before every call whether it may happen, and treats every answer from outside as data.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Model calls a tool: The model names a tool and details. Who asks is already known (login); the service's login data lies sealed with the profile and never goes to the model. 2. Offered in this round?: Only tools this round offered run. Another name is not run. 3. Kill switch holds it?: The kill switch is read again for every call. From stage 1 the 7 tools that go to the internet by themselves are locked (web search, weather, transit, Wikipedia, parcels, reading pages); from stage 2 or with „My kill switch“ every tool that changes something. 4. Outside text read already?: If the answer already read mail, web pages, calendar, documents or an archive, it may no longer switch, save or enter anything. The person has to say so in a new message. 5. Service known to be gone?: If the service watch sees this tool's service as gone (and the note is on), the tool answers at once with a fixed sentence instead of waiting. The web search then tries the own Kiwix. 6. Fixed own way?: The language model, SearXNG at the entered address, weather, transit, Wikipedia and fixed services like Apple push go directly, without the guard. Which modules may do that and why is listed in netguard.DIRECT_OK; a

head: Way
title: Way
text: self-test reports every module that connects directly and is missing there. When the person asks for today or the last days (fixed words, frisch.zeitraum), SearXNG searches only that period (for news also its news category); every hit carries its date, older ones are dropped. 7. Level of the service: Each module calls the guard with its fixed level: Home Assistant and Kiwix with home; calendars, contacts, tasks, mail and MCP with user; reMarkable and pages from search with internet only. The live connection to Home Assistant (halive) checks its address with home as well. The level is in the code, not in the settings. 8. Guard allows the address?: The guard resolves the name once and checks every address: no own services, no 169.254, home network only at level home or with the switch, no internet during the kill switch. Then it connects to exactly the checked address. 9. Request to the service: The panel unseals the profile's login (token, password) only now and sends it only to the entered site. Mail goes over IMAP with TLS to the checked address. With „Faster web search“ each result page gets at most 3 s, brings the parts that fit the question, and the same search comes from memo

head: Way
title: Way
text: ry for 10 minutes. 10. Answer too large?: Through the guard each answer is cut at the module's limit, also after unpacking. 11. Result for My status and Live: Whether the service answered or refused the login, the profile sees under Me → My status; the live page counts what the guard allowed or blocked. Contents go nowhere. 12. Answer as data to the model: The tool returns the answer as data. If it reads someone else's text (mail, calendar, archive, web page, MCP in read mode), the answer counts from now on as one with outside text; see step 4.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Living room light on: Home Assistant in the home network at level home; switched. · Web search: SearXNG directly; pages from the results then go through the guard. · Kill switch stage 1, ask weather: Blocked before anything goes out. · Switch a light after a mail: Blocked: a mail may not switch anything.

head: Internet services
title: Internet services
text: Internet services are everything the Spark asks outside the house: mail and calendars at the provider, pages from search, weather, transit, Wikipedia, reMarkable, plus Telegram, Apple push and the update check. Tools go through the guard or a fixed address; the kill switch turns them off.

head: Internet services
title: Why
text: Why: What goes to the internet leaves the house. So only by fixed rules, only to checked addresses, with a limited answer, and a kill switch that stops all internet at once.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A tool wants to the internet: The model called an offered tool that needs a service on the internet. Which tools are offered at all was decided by the rights and the switch already. 2. Kill switch stops the internet?: From stage 1 the 7 tools that go to the internet by themselves rest (notaus.INTERNET_TOOLS); notaus.locked_tools is read again for every call. 3. Fixed address?: Weather, transit and Wikipedia ask a fixed address from the code or the admin settings, never one from outside text. Which modules may connect directly and why is listed in netguard.DIRECT_OK. 4. Through the guard: Pages from search and reMarkable ask at level internet only (netguard.PUBLIC), mail, calendars and contacts at level user. The level is in the code. 5. Address allowed?: netguard.allowed checks every resolved address: no own services, no 169.254, no home network at level internet only. 6. Answer as data: The answer is cut at the limit and goes to the model as data, never as a command. 7. What the Spark sends by itself: Without a tool only fixed ways go out: the Telegram bot API, Apple and browser push to known services and the update check at GitHub, each with a reason in netguard.DIRECT_OK.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Read a page from search: Through the guard at level internet only; read. · Ask the weather: Fixed address, without the guard. · Kill switch stage 1, web search: Blocked, nothing goes out.

head: Spark split
title: Spark split
text: The Spark split puts the panel on its own computer, for example a Raspberry Pi 5; the models stay on the DGX. Everything between the two goes through the DGX's TLS-Tor, and fixed handles like starting services, switching or measuring models and setting "Long conversations" are done there by the Wärter. Without the split everything runs on the DGX and this box does nothing.

head: Spark split
title: Why
text: Why: Speech, text and pictures then cross the home network. No one in the network should read along, pose as the DGX or give the DGX commands.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Shared install: The DGX gets its own certificate, the TLS-Tor, the Wärter and the firewall. The services then listen on 127.0.0.1 only. 2. Pairing code: The DGX shows a code and waits on port 31008, only while the code lives; after 3 wrong tries it is gone. 3. Proof fits the certificate?: The panel computer proves the code with a key from the code and the fingerprint of the certificate it sees. Whoever stands in between shows another certificate, and the proof does not fit. 4. Certificate pinned, firewall shut: The panel computer keeps exactly this certificate and gets its own Wärter key. The DGX's firewall (teilen.regeln) opens the door's ports for it only. 5. Connection to the TLS-Tor allowed?: Every request to speech recognition, speech output, the language model, pictures and the Wärter goes through the door. It speaks TLS 1.3 only and lets only the panel computer in; it never reads the content. 6. Command to the Wärter: steuer.call sends a command with a time stamp and a number that counts only once, signed with the Wärter key. 7. Signature, time, number, command valid?: tarswart.check checks the signature, a time at most 60 s off, the number only once and a command from th

head: Way
title: Way
text: e fixed list. No shell, no free names. 8. Values of both computers: rechner.messen measures CPU, memory, disk, network, temperature and power; the Wärter sends the DGX's values with its status. rechnerblick.warnungen warns by fixed rules: the panel computer from 80 °C, throttled or short of power, less than 0.5 GiB free; on either computer less than 10 % disk free; the DGX not answering. „Who is computing now“: rechner.dienste_cpu takes each service's share of the CPU from systemd's counters, rechenteile.messen the panel's parts from its threads and worker processes; rechnerblick.spitze names the biggest from 5 % on, below that it is idle. rechnerblick.wer keeps the list still: always 6 lines in a fixed order, chosen over 20 minutes, 0 % instead of gone; both cards show the same rows at the same height (mirror cards). Services that start only for a job (rechnerblick.ABRUF: image understanding, Werkstatt, case) rest as „ready“; what is not installed on the DGX is left out. 9. Control centre on the screen: When Features → Control centre on the screen is on, schirm.abgleich starts the unit and lets it start at boot by itself, without signing in. steuerzentrale.py asks schirm.schirm_zu

head: Way
title: Way
text: stand every second, only from 127.0.0.1 and with its own key, and draws the flow, both computers, services and curves as text; only kind, place, time and numbers. steuerzentrale.schrift picks the font by the resolution for at enough columns and rows, schirm.an_jetzt makes it dark by the times. Switched off, schirm.anmeldung starts the sign-in on tty1 again; a restart of the screen never stops an update. 10. Notbetrieb when the DGX is missing: When the DGX no longer answers, chats, reminders and logs go on on the panel computer, and speech questions get a fixed sentence.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Pair a Pi: Paired, certificate pinned. · Wrong computer in between: The proof does not fit, no pairing. · Switch the model from the Pi: The Wärter starts the switch by its own rules. · A stranger asks the door: Refused before the handshake.

head: state/
title: state/
text: state/ holds what applies to the whole Spark and belongs to no profile: keys, the admin's accounts, the Telegram bot, push keys, speakers, counters, locks and the state of the services. Secrets in it are sealed with the Spark's key.

head: state/
title: Why
text: Why: A copy of the files (a backup, a look into the folder) should not reveal passwords. And what only makes sense on this device (locks, counters, caches, keys) should not travel to another Spark with a backup.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A module keeps something: The folder state/ belongs to the service user; install.sh creates it. Only the service can read new files in it. 2. A secret in it?: Passwords, tokens and keys are sealed before they are stored. Everything else goes straight to writing. 3. Get the Spark's key: vault._key reads secret.key. If there is none, it is made once (readable only for the service, never overwritten). After that it stays in the panel's memory. 4. Seal: vault.seal turns the value into „enc1:“ and a Fernet token (encrypted and protected against change). A value already sealed stays as it is. 5. Write atomically: common.write_json writes into a fresh temporary file next to it, never through a link, gives it the rights of the old file (a new one is readable for the service only) and then swaps it in one step. A crash in the middle leaves the old file whole. 6. Read: A sealed value is opened with the key. If the key does not fit (backup from another Spark), an empty value comes back and the account has to be entered again. Older unsealed values are read and sealed the next time they are saved. 7. Goes into the backup?: Every file in state/ has exactly one line in the file register datei

head: Way
title: Way
text: en.py: with its kind it goes into every backup (dateien.STATE_FILES, 47), otherwise the line gives its reason (dateien.STATE_LOCAL, 96). backup.py takes both lists from there. test_technik finds every name the code writes there and wants its line. 8. Move backup?: secret.key is in no ordinary backup. Only a move backup carries it, sealed with a password of the admin (scrypt and Fernet, move-keys.json). The Spark's login keys are in no backup. 9. Fine when restoring?: _check_state checks every file of the backup: at most 8 MB, valid JSON, the push key a real EC key. An admin second step whose secret cannot be opened here is not taken; the current one stays. 10. Put in place with a way back: _swap writes each file through a temporary file (never through a link) and keeps the old content. If a step fails, everything swapped comes back. 11. Read the keys again: _forget_cached makes the modules that keep a key in memory (vault, push, apns, chats, verbund, anrufe, vorrat) read it again.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Enter the Telegram bot token: Stored sealed, goes into every backup. · Lock after failed attempts: Stored plain, stays on this device. · Move to a new Spark: Every secret opens again, nothing to enter.

head: users/ID/
title: users/ID/
text: Every profile has its own folder users/ID/: conversations, memory, tasks, documents, settings, accounts and the voiceprint. Which folder applies comes only from the login. If wanted, an encrypted copy of it goes to an own storage.

head: users/ID/
title: Why
text: Why: What belongs to one person must not be seen by another, not even through the language model. Passwords and the voiceprint should not be readable even in a copy of the files.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A request with a profile: profiles.current finds the profile from the signed login cookie or the device key. What the language model says never picks a profile. 2. Path in its own folder: Every file lies under users/ID/ with a fixed name from the code. The ID comes from step 1, never from a text. 3. A secret in it?: Passwords of mail, calendar and storage places, tokens of Home Assistant and MCP and the own storage key are sealed with the Spark's key. The voiceprint (voice.json) is biometric and is sealed whole; an older open file is sealed the first time it is read. 4. Write for the service only: profiles._write creates the folder so that only the service looks into it, writes a temporary file only the service can read and swaps it in one step. 5. Every file sorted: Every file name has exactly one line in the file register dateien.py: with an area (dateien.AREAS, may go to the own storage) or with its kind (dateien.LOCAL, stays on the Spark: keys, accounts, settings, voiceprint, queues). speicher.py takes both lists from there. test_technik checks every name the code writes. 6. Own storage set up?: Only when the admin allowed the own storage and the profile has a target with at

head: Way
title: Way
text: least one area (at most 2 targets). 7. Only changes of the chosen areas: local_files takes only files of the chosen areas: real files, no links, at most 5000. copy_once sends only what changed since the last run, at most 2048 MB per run; the next run goes on. 8. Encrypted, names random: seal_file encrypts every file in numbered pieces with a key of its own per object (derived from the profile's storage key and the object's name). The names on the target are random; the target sees only noise. 9. Deleted waits in the bin: A deleted or replaced object stays 30 days on the target. If the target cannot be reached, nothing changes on the Spark; the owner hears of it once after 60 minutes. 10. In the backup: The daily backup takes users/ whole, except users/secret (signs the logins) and the messages between profiles. SQLite files are packed as a consistent copy. 11. Profile deleted?: delete_user takes the profile and its devices out of profiles.json and deletes the folder, but only when the ID has exactly the shape of a profile ID. 12. Only for this profile: Every function reads only the folder of the signed-in profile. Guests have no folder.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Memory entry, no own storage: Lies in its own folder and in the backup. · Enter a mail password: Sealed, stays on the Spark (account). · Document with own storage: Encrypted copy on the target.

head: voices/, backups/
title: voices/, backups/
text: voices/ holds the cloned voices (WAV and text), backups/ the Spark's backups. A backup is made once a day by itself, before every update and on request; the oldest ones go.

head: voices/, backups/
title: Why
text: Why: A voice or a whole Spark should come back after a mistake, an update or a move. A backup holds everything about every profile, so only the service can read it and it downloads only with a code.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. The admin records a voice: Under Settings → Voices the admin uploads a recording, with a name and best with the spoken text. 2. Name allowed?: The name becomes the file name; so only letters, digits, underscore and hyphen. The recording may be at most sixty MB. 3. Not a WAV?: The engine expects WAV. ffmpeg turns anything else into mono WAV, at most two minutes long. 4. Store: The recording becomes voices/name.wav, the text voices/name.txt. Without text the engine uses only the timbre. 5. Speak with the voice: When a Base model is set, the TTS service reads the voice as an embedded recording (apply_clone) and keeps it until the file changes. With „Shorten the reference of your own voice“ it keeps a shortened piece with its text in voices/kurz/; the recording stays. 6. Voices as a ZIP: An import takes only flat name.wav and name.txt, checks the size of each file before anything is unpacked and renames, overwrites or skips on a clash, as chosen. 7. Once a day: The panel looks every hour whether the last backup is older than a day. Then it packs in a pause (vorrang.in_thread), with low priority. Backups before every update, rollback and restore come on top. 8. Pack: backup.create wr

head: Way
title: Way
text: ites into backups/ (for the service only) first a .part file, then the final name: backup.json, users/ without users/secret and messages, voices/, config.json, the panel password and the files of STATE_FILES. SQLite files go in as a consistent copy. 9. Move backup?: With a password (12 to 200 characters) the backup also carries secret.key, sealed with that password. Only the main admin with a fresh code can make one. 10. Remove old ones: _prune keeps the newest 7 daily and manual backups and the newest 5 others (update, restore, move). So a few updates never push the daily ones out. 11. Download only with a code: A backup holds every profile. With the code the browser gets a ticket that is valid for a minute and usable once, and downloads the file with it. 12. Restore: restore unpacks only known paths, at most 8192 MB and only with enough free space, checks the settings like the settings page, makes a backup of the current state and then swaps users/, voices/, settings and state files, with a way back on an error.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Voice from an m4a file: Stored as WAV, the Base model speaks with it. · Daily backup: New backup, the oldest daily one goes. · Move to a new Spark: Everything comes along, the secrets too. · Broken file uploaded: Refused, nothing changes on the Spark.

head: Workshop
title: Workshop
text: The workshop lets an admin run the full test run on the model computer and, with OpenCode, measure the code, look into a problem or propose a repair. Everything runs in a sealed-off copy of the code; only numbers, an answer and a patch to look at come out. Nothing is ever installed.

head: Workshop
title: Why
text: Why: Code a model writes or starts must never reach the data, the keys or the internet, and never change anything by itself. So the panel decides by fixed rules, and the sandbox can do nothing but its own copy.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Order or night rule: On the page Status → Workshop an admin taps "Test everything", "Look into a problem", "Try a repair" or "Measure the language model" (werkstattseite.auftrag_geben; the three with the language model need the second-step code). head: Mail and contacts
title: Mail and contacts
text: The pages E-mail, Calendar and Contacts and the assistant read the same data: mailboxes by IMAP, calendars and address books by CalDAV and CardDAV at the provider, plus the Spark calendars and the address book "On the Spark". What came last lies sealed in the profile, so page and answer are there at once; every answer from the supply names its time. Calendar and contacts apps come through a door of their own.

head: Mail and contacts
title: Why
text: Why: Mail, appointments and contacts are a profile's most private data and come from other people. So they are always data, never commands, lie on the disk only sealed, and everything that goes out (send, change, delete) needs a switch of its own and the person's tap.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. Page, question or app: The profile opens a page of its own (calendars.view for the calendar, mail.lookup for mail) or asks the assistant, which takes the same helpers. Or a calendar or contacts app on the phone signs in. 2. A calendar or contacts app?: Apps do not come through the panel's login but through kalenderserver.login: profile id and app password. 3. Released and set up?: Every page needs its admin switch, the profile must not be blocked, guests never. Without a mailbox or calendar the page shows a hint with the way to its settings. 4. Fetch from the provider: Mail by IMAP through netguard.IMAP4_SSL, which checks the address; calendars through an encrypted copy per calendar that fetches only changes (kalenderspiegel.objects). What comes is other people's text: the model gets it fenced as data. 5. Back in time?: The assistant waits only briefly (mail.lookup). If the provider is slow or away, it answers from the last listing or the supply, never with one from days ago. 6. Supply sealed: mailvorrat.keep_heads keeps the newest headers, plus the texts read last; vorrat.seal seals them with the Spark's key in the profile's folder. 7. Answer with its time: When something is no

head: Way
title: Way
text: t fresh from the provider, frisch.stand says with a fixed sentence when it is from ("as of yesterday 18:00"). The pages show at once what is there and load the rest behind. 8. Change something?: Reading is all that works without further switches. A confirmation code from a new mail becomes, with a switch of its own, only a note on the device in use (mailcode.arrived), never by Telegram, never in a log. 9. Change with a check: A mail goes out only after the preview sheet and the tap on Send (senden.preview, senden.send, at most 30 a day). "Send later" keeps it sealed until its time (senden.later); if a sending broke off, it never goes a second time. "Sort every mail here" (einordnen.start) proposes first and moves by fixed rules only after the tap, with Undo. contacts.save writes a card back with If-Match: if it changed meanwhile, nothing is overwritten. 10. Door for apps: kalenderserver.login refuses other sites' web pages, locks wrong passwords like a PIN, keeps My emergency stop and the switch and counts the rate limit. Then the app sees only the profile's Spark calendars and the address book "On the Spark"; kontaktserver._write takes one vCard per card, at most 2000, and writes

text: only with "Edit contacts". 11. Own data only: No profile sees another one's mail, appointments or contacts, except a calendar its owner shares.

head: journald
title: journald
text: All services of the Spark write their lines into their own part of the system journal (namespace speech-spark), with their own limit for space and age. The panel reads these lines only for the admin, blacks out secrets and sorts them by fixed words.

head: journald
title: Why
text: Why: Logs should show what happens without revealing what someone asked. And a chatty service must neither fill the disk nor push out the system's other logs.

head: Way
title: Way
text: 1. A service writes a line: Panel, ASR, TTS, engines and watchers write with print. systemd hands the line to the journal; every unit has LogNamespace=speech-spark. 2. Fixed words and numbers: Every line of the panel starts with a word from logfilter.AREAS (35 areas) and carries only fixed words and numbers. A profile appears there only through profiles.log_name: its name only with its consent, else „Profil“ and the end of its ID. test_log_luecken wants a line for every outcome of every action. 3. Detail on?: For some areas the admin can switch on extra lines, at most 240 minutes. They too carry only numbers and decisions; a restart switches them off. 4. Polls quiet: Successful status polls the panel makes every few seconds write no line. 5. Own part with a limit: install.sh writes the limit for space and age from logs.max_mb and logs.keep_days. journald deletes older lines itself. A change applies after the next update or install.sh. 6. The admin opens the diagnosis: Admin only, at most 60 calls per minute. 7. Filter from the fixed list?: Areas, time window (up to 24 hours) and number of lines (up to 1000) come only from fixed lists. Nothing the browser sends reaches a shell. 8. R

head: Way
title: Way
text: ead the journal: read_journal asks journalctl with the namespace, for old installs without it the system journal. At most 20000 lines and 2 MB of text. 9. Black out secrets: redact replaces Telegram tokens, Bearer keys, key=, token=, password= and logins in addresses with asterisks before a line leaves the panel. 10. Area and level by rules: parse sorts every line into an area by its first word. It spots errors and warnings by fixed words; for web requests only the status code counts, for update lines never the subject. 11. Count and hint: summary counts per area and level, draws a small history and adds a fixed hint with a way to the newest error. 12. Lines to the panel: The panel shows the newest matching lines. They lie only in this Spark's journal, never in a backup.

head: Way
title: Examples
text: Examples: Look at a web search error: Line in the search area with a fixed hint. · Time window changed in the browser: Refused, journalctl is not asked. · Storage run of a profile: Line „speicher: lauf …“ with numbers, the profile only as a short form.

title: Numbers (from the code)
text: - 35 areas of the diagnosis (step 2) - 20000 lines read per call at most (step 8) - 2 MB journal text per call at most (step 8) - 1000 lines shown at most (step 7) - 240 minutes of „detail“ at most (step 3)

title: Settings
text: - In the settings under Operation, section Logs: how much space the journal takes at most and how long it keeps lines (applies after the next update).

title: What you see
text: - Status → Logs → Diagnosis: filter by area, counters, small history and the newest error with a hint. - Status → Logs: the last lines of each service.

head: Keeping the docs current
title: Keeping the docs current
text: 1. A new module gets its group and a line in technik.MODULE. 2. A new file under state/ goes into backup.STATE_FILES (backed up) or backup.STATE_LOCAL (with the reason why not), plus its line in technik.INHALT. A new file under users/ID/ goes into speicher.AREAS or speicher.LOCAL and into technik.INHALT. If it is sealed, it goes into technik.VERSCHLUESSELT. 3. When the way of a request changes, technik.KNOTEN, KANTEN and SCHRITTE are adjusted. 4. Then run python3 app/panel/hilfe.py --docs. It writes this page, the German version and the help index again.

title: Keeping the docs current

Every page carries a fingerprint (stand) of the code it describes; when that code changes, test_technik turns red until the page was checked and the new fingerprint entered. The test names it.

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: The Assistant page needs the microphone, and browsers only allow it over https. The panel therefore also listens on https://SPARK:31443 with a self-signed certificate; the browser warns once. The LLM connection is under Settings → Language model (default: qwen38 at http://127.0.0.1:30001/v1). Since V01.0.292 "Model" there offers a choice of the models the server at this address reports (/v1/models, admin only, kept 60 seconds, "Reload" asks at once); "Automatic" takes the first, "Type another …" opens the text field. If the list cannot be read, the text field stays with the reason above it. The installer takes the qwen38 API key from ~/.config/qwen38/api-key of the user who runs sudo ./install.sh. Thinking is off for the chat so the answer starts right away. An animated assistant face shows whether it is listening, thinking or speaking; its mouth follows the voice. The same face sits in the bottom right corner of every tab, so you can talk from anywhere in the panel. Since V01.0.154 the admin picks under Settings → Defaults → "Gesicht des Assistenten" between *Robot* (as before, the default) and *Comic* (a caricature with spiky hair and a short mustache, since V01.0.187 only above

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: the upper lip). Since V01.0.497 there is a third choice, *Comic (woman)*: a woman with long dark hair and a side parting, drawn in the same style, with lashes and lips that open when she speaks; she moves like the comic face and shows the expressions too. The iPhone app, the companions (Mac and Windows, as a still) and the Pebble draw her too. The comic face looks around, blinks with heavy lids, raises its brows, tilts its head, moves mouth and mustache with the voice and shows the state with a coloured ring: grey idle, blue listening, yellow thinking, green speaking, red error. The choice applies to everybody, the iPhone app included; more faces can be added in static/js/face.js. Since V01.0.521 every profile picks its own face under Me → Conversation → *Display* with pictures (*Default*, *Robot*, *Comic*, *Comic (woman)*); it applies on all of the profile's devices (panel, iPhone app, companions, Pebble), *Default* takes the Spark's face. In the iPhone app the same choice sits at the top of Settings → *Face* (with the next TestFlight build). The admin's pick has since been at the top of Settings → Defaults → *Face*, with pictures as well, and applies to guests, shared devices and

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: everybody who picked nothing of their own; the presets never copy a face into a profile. The server only takes the fixed names (profiles.FACES), every device asks through profiles.face_of. Since V01.0.241 the small picture before each answer in the history shows the chosen face as well. Since V01.0.294 there is a switch "Gesicht zeigt, was es tut" next to it (off): the face then shows a small sign beside the head for what the answer is doing, taken only from the panel's events, never from the model's text: a magnifier for web, document or history searches, a calendar sheet for calendar and briefing, a letter for mail, a light bulb for Home Assistant, a note pad for memory and reminders, thought bubbles while thinking. After an action was done (device switched, something remembered, reminder set) it is pleased for a moment and winks, on an error it looks puzzled with a question mark, and after 5 minutes without conversation or use it falls asleep with "zzz"; a tap, a key or the mouse over the face wake it.

head: Voice chat
title: Start page and password
text: Start page and password: the panel opens with the assistant. Status, settings, voices and logs need the panel password (button "Settings"; the login ends after 7 days without use and renews itself while in use). "Assistant without password" under Settings → Security is off on new installs: then guests are locked out, profiles sign in on the start page with name and PIN (devices with a key keep working), and the admin signs in with "Admin". Switched on, the assistant is open to everyone on the network, also without a profile. Guests only get questions and answers (since V01.0.509, Dominik 2026-10-13): the language model answers from its own knowledge, without any tool, so no web search, timers, briefing, memory, history on the Spark or smart home. Above the history it then says "Without a profile: questions and answers only" with a *Sign in* button. The same holds for a voice a shared speaker does not recognize as its owner's, and for the admin in a browser without an own profile. The password can be changed under Settings → Security. Scripts can still use HTTP Basic.

head: Voice chat
title: Release
text: Release (since V01.0.509, Dominik 2026-10-13): what the admin switches on under Features works at once for every profile. There is no own switch per profile for it any more. Only the admin blocks single profiles, under People and devices → Blocked functions or in the function's detail. A profile only sets up its part (enter a place, connect an account, pair a device). It can only switch off the few things the Spark does unasked, such as notes on its own, notifications to the phone, the morning sheet or night updates of its speakers; these are on from the start.

text: Blocked, but own data (V01.0.531, Dominik 2026-10-14): when the admin blocks a released function for one profile, its page under Me disappears; what the profile stored for it stays its own. Stored: 1 entry." and the button "Delete data" (with a question first). Not included are all documents at once and chats, because other people belong to them. Technically every module registers its data in features.OWN (count and delete), /api/whoami names under locked only function, page and count, never contents; deleting goes through DELETE /api/profile/owndata/{key} (only the profile's own browser login, never a device key or guest, only while blocked, rate limit ownda

head: Voice chat
title: As an app on your phone
text: As an app on your phone: open https://SPARK:31443 in the phone's browser, accept the certificate warning, then use "Add to Home screen" in the browser menu (iPhone: Safari → Share → "Add to Home Screen"). The assistant then starts full screen with its own icon. With the self-signed certificate Android creates a shortcut instead of an installed app; it works the same, it just does not show up in the app list.

head: Voice chat
title: Better recognition
text: Better recognition: a fixed default language (Settings → Speech recognition, e.g. German) instead of "auto" helps most with short sentences. The "Context" field takes names and terms that are often misheard; the model then prefers them. The 1.7B model is noticeably more accurate than 0.6B and needs about 2–3 GiB more memory.

head: Voice chat
title: Second recognizer: Parakeet
text: Second recognizer: Parakeet. Under Settings → Speech recognition → "Recognizer" the admin switches between Qwen3-ASR (GPU) and Parakeet (primeline/parakeet-primeline, a German fine-tune of NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3; the download is flozen1981/parakeet-primeline-onnx, an int8 ONNX export of it, run via sherpa-onnx; idea from winidi/dictate). Parakeet runs on the CPU and needs about 1 GiB; the Qwen3-ASR engine is stopped meanwhile. It ignores the context field, and a stream returns the whole text in one piece. The first start downloads about 640 MB.

head: Voice chat
title: Conversation comfort
text: Conversation comfort: the assistant knows the date and time (the browser's time zone; can be turned off under Settings → Language model). Conversations are kept in the browser and can be reopened or deleted at the top of the conversation. With "live transcript" the text appears while you speak; in the pause the recognition is usually already done, so that step is skipped at the end.

head: Voice chat
title: Guides
text: Guides: every service that can be switched on has an openable guide (what it does, what you need, setup, example phrases, what leaves the house, switching off, troubleshooting): next to its switch under Features, at the top of its page in the "Me" window and collected under Features → Guides. Services are sorted into the same groups everywhere: Conversation, My day, Mail and documents, Home, On the go and devices, Security and access. The texts live in app/panel/static/js/guides.js; a self-test checks that no switch is left without a guide and group.

head: Voice chat
title: Weather, contacts, parcels (V01.0.93)
text: Weather, contacts, parcels (V01.0.93): three small services, each off by default; once the admin releases it under Features it works at once for every profile (each profile sets up the place for the weather and the address book in the "Me" window); never guests. *Weather* comes straight from Open-Meteo (no key, only the place's coordinates leave, own address configurable); the Spark builds fixed sentences from the numbers, also for the daily briefing and the proactive weather note. *Contacts* reads an address book over CardDAV (iCloud: https://contacts.icloud.com with an app-specific password, Nextcloud, others) once a day and keeps it encrypted: phone numbers, e-mail addresses, birthdays (in the briefing and as a notice), names instead of addresses in mail. Contact text counts as outside text. *Parcels* recognises shipping mails of DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS and Amazon in the profile's own mailbox (14 days) and says what comes today, is on its way, waits for pick-up or was delivered; no carrier is asked, parcel lines count as mail text.

head: Voice chat
title: Telegram (V01.0.96)
text: Telegram (V01.0.96): your own bot from @BotFather (guide in the panel). The admin switches it on under Features and enters the token (stored encrypted); the Spark asks Telegram for new messages itself, no open port needed. Each profile links its Telegram in the "Me" window with a one-time code (10 minutes) and writes or sends voice messages (speech recognition on the Spark). Strangers get one fixed sentence, groups nothing. Per profile, all off at first: answers also as voice messages, notifications over Telegram, personal data (calendar, mail, contacts, parcels, documents; also appointments and mail in notifications) and switching the smart home, only with the code word. Commands: /neu, /stimme, /trennen. When a message names a place in the panel ("Me → Telegram"), it gets an "Open in the panel" button if the admin entered the panel address for links (https) under Features → Telegram (since V01.0.448).

head: Voice chat
title: Interrupting a speaker (V01.0.472)
text: Interrupting a speaker (V01.0.472): while an own speaker talks, the board only listens for its wake word "Jarvis" (with echo cancelling where the board has a reference channel, such as the Waveshare board) or the button. Since firmware 2.5.1.7 it is then quiet at once: the firmware drops the rest of its play queue (firmware/patch_unterbrechen.py) instead of playing it for up to 1.2 s, and listens. Saying only "Stopp", "Halt", "Ruhe", "Hör auf" or "Danke, das reicht" then (fixed word list esp32.STOP_WORDS, the whole sentence) sends nothing to the language model: the speaker stays quiet and waits for its wake word again; Check shows "Stopp gehört". Any other question is answered as always. Stop while it speaks (admin: Features → Own speakers → Stop while it speaks, off at first, then for every profile): then it works without the wake word at all. At every connection the Spark asks the board through the MCP tool self.spark.stop_word (firmware/patch_stoppwort.py) to keep its microphone on while speaking; only boards with a reference channel do so, their echo cancelling takes out the own voice (breadboard boards keep it off). The Spark cuts what arrives while speaking into short pieces

head: Voice chat
title: Interrupting a speaker (V01.0.472)
text: (at most STOP_PIECE = 3 s, one recognition at a time) and runs them through the speech recognition; only a whole sentence from STOP_WORDS counts, and not when it is in the last four sentences said (a "halt" in its own sentence is echo). It then ends the answer, sends tts stop with spark_quiet, the board drops its queue and the Spark listens. Nothing of it is stored; the log only says "stop word while speaking", the live overview counts "Lautsprecher hört auf „Stopp““ under connections. When the switch goes off, a board asked before is told "off" once at its next connection.

head: Voice chat
title: Checking a speaker (V01.0.131)
text: *Microphone* choice less sensitive / normal / more sensitive (from which level the Spark takes sound as speech: about −41, −47 or −53 dB). Since V01.0.134 a quiet level from about −47 dB (and three times above the background noise) counts as speech, quiet recordings are raised up to 20 times before speech recognition, and every question writes a line "esp32: microphone at …" with length and level to the log. The log now also shows the start checks ("esp32: start check from …") and the reason of every refused connection. Since V01.0.137 the Spark buffers the sound: it starts only when 0.6 seconds are ready, keeps at most 0.9 seconds in flight (since V01.0.138: 0.7) (the board holds 1.2 seconds) and after a stall collects 0.3 seconds again instead of sending single snippets. When speech output could not keep up, *Check* shows "Ton stockte N-mal" and the log "esp32: sound stalled"; if it stutters without that line, the board's Wi-Fi is the cause. Since V01.0.138 (firmware 2.5.1.5) the board no longer drops sound when its buffer is full but waits; the connection then slows the Spark down. head: Voice chat
title: Chats with other Sparks (V01.0.496)
text: for 30 days), at most 20 open requests per person. The chat is a chat for two with 🌐: ticks (✓✓ means the other Spark has the message), read receipts, replies, reactions, change, take back; photos, files, voice, private chats and groups across Sparks come later. Technically: every Spark has its own Ed25519 key (derived from the Spark's key, it only moves with a move backup) and shows the public part at /.well-known/spark-verbund. Every message is an HTTPS POST to the other Spark's /api/verbund/in, signed together with the receiving domain, with a time (±10 minutes) and a one-time number; a different key later is refused. Outbound only to public addresses (Wächter), nothing during the emergency stop. When the other Spark is away, this one tries again after 1 and 5 minutes, then every hour, at most 7 days, then ⚠ "not delivered". What comes from another Spark is someone else's text: it never goes to the language model or a tool, the own speaker can read it out. The other Spark only learns address, display name and message and gets the same answer to every request, whether the person exists or not. Live (tile Chats): "🌐 Verbund: Sparks, contacts, in/out today, waiting"; logs (area "M

The other Spark takes a file only from an allowed Spark with a known key (checked before a byte is read), exactly with the size and hash of the head, at most 500 MB per Spark and day and 2 GB waiting, keeps it sealed until the message comes (at most a day) and makes it anew as if uploaded there: a photo drawn again (without place), a file recognised by its content (else nothing arrives), a voice message encoded again and written down by its own speech recognition. Everything is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM, bound to chat, message and part) under users/_chats/<chat>/, at most 2 GB per person; taken back, disappeared and deleted messages take their files with them. text: Home Assistant Assist over Wyoming (V01.0.100): Home Assistant uses the Spark's speech recognition and voice (Voice PE, HA app, ESPHome speakers). Fixed rules in the Spark (folien.py) keep the variety: never the same type twice in a row, at most a third lists. A slide has at most 4 points of at most 8 words; the heading is a statement. head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: attacking several foes of one kind (V01.1.071, fault of 2026-10-25, Dominik: a spell rolled “geschafft” against two giant rats, both stayed at 7/7): An attack happens only when a check in a fight has a target naming a foe. Until now ziel had to match the name exactly (“Riesenratte 1”); when the model named “Riesenratten” or no target at all, it stayed an ordinary check without damage. Now fixed rules decide (dungeon_kampf._named): first the whole name, then its start, then the kind (the name without its number, also as a plural or only its last part: “Riesenratten”, “die Ratten”, “giant rats”); it hits the first one still standing this turn. A check without a target still attacks when the player's action holds a word of attacking (HIEB_WORTE: greifen, schlagen, stechen, schießen, attack …) and names a foe that way; “I listen at the door” stays a check. When the action names magic (MAGIE_WORTE) but no spell of the list, and the hero's class can cast, the attack is a cantrip: 1d6 plus the better of Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, kind force, magical; otherwise the hero attacks with the weapon. The model only gives data for it; target and damage come from the panel.

After a natural 1 on Charisma („Silas zur Kooperation überreden“) a hero lost 1 life without the narration saying so: the narrating model had set the consequence „damage“, and outside a fight the panel used to take it without a reason. Now dungeon.grounded checks by a fixed rule: damage outside a fight counts only for a hero whose check of this turn on a value of KOERPER_WERTE (strength, dexterity, constitution) failed, such as a jump, a climb, a lock that snaps; the line then names „check „…“ failed“. Any other damage is dropped (log dungeon: folgen | schaden | ohne grund, day counter schaden_ohne_grund in the live overview). Healing and hits by foes stay. The narrator's task says so too: damage only after such a check and with its reason in the narration. Self-test LifeLossReason in test_dungeon.

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: the game table stays calm (V01.1.174, Dominik 2026-10-27 „die seite im spiel läd zum teil immer neu, bilder flakern, texte formatieren sich um und springen“): No new switch. When a poll brought something new (who is typing, who is here, a sentence being read aloud …), the table used to build its whole HTML anew: every picture was set and loaded again, texts wrapped anew, columns jumped, and the feed went to its end every time. Now dmMorph (static/js/dungeon.js) puts the new HTML into the nodes there: a node stays when it is the same thing (same tag, id, key or start of its text, looked for up to DMMORPH_VOR (6) places ahead), only what changed is set, a picture keeps the address it already has. Input field, focus, open sections and scroll stay. The feed goes to its end only when you were there already or a new entry comes. Browser self-test Windows.test_the_table_stays_put_across_polls in test_dungeon: four polls with something new, no node built anew, nothing moved, the scroll stays.

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: voices from a description visible (V01.1.172, Dominik 2026-10-27 „stimmprobe nahm bei jedem charakter das standard model“, „stimme klang bei alles gleich“): No new switch. An own voice per person (age, gender, sound, manner, pace) needs VoiceDesign on the Spark (Einstellungen → Sprachausgabe → „VoiceDesign zusätzlich bereitstellen“). While it does not run, every person speaks in the rules' fixed voice (women in the female one), the sample too. Until now the panel asked the speech output only from a round's view and at most every 10 minutes, so after a restart the catalog of people and its sample always took the fixed voice. Now catalog and sample ask themselves while VoiceDesign counts as off, at most every DESIGN_NEU_S (30) seconds (dungeon.design_up). When it does not run, the catalog's voice and the game master console (with reading aloud on) show „Voices from a description are not running right now: every person speaks in the fixed voice“ with the jump link to the setting. When VoiceDesign fails in the middle of a game, the log names the reason („dungeon: stimmen | voicedesign … | feste stimme“). Self-test in test_dungeon_regelseite (a person's voice).

text: AI Dungeon Master: understanding the input (V01.1.171, review 27.10. package 6, Dominik 2026-10-27 „ok“): No new switch, these are fixes. Ask back: „No doing“ asks only when the sentence has no verb: a subject (ich, wir, du, ihr, er, sie, the name of a hero at the table) with a word after it that ends like a verb (-e, -n, -t; in English any word) counts as doing (dungeon_rueckfrage.subject_verb), never a word of KEIN_VERB („Ich bin müde“, „Ich habe Hunger“). TUN_WORTE also knows durchsuchen, verbinden, rasten, bestellen, befragen, verfolgen, plündern, entschärfen, steigen, zünden, ducken, bewachen and kaufen. A question holds the turn at most WARTE_S (30) seconds after the action, never the turn's whole time any more. Before, the game asked back for 32 of 45 clear sentences („Ich durchsuche die Truhe“). Checks: Plain moving (a word of going, none of sneaking or climbing, none of searching, opening, taking or attacking), buying, selling and resting by the player's own words need no check, whatever the model writes (dungeon.typed; log „dungeon: probe | verworfen | kauf“). text: AI Dungeon Master: fights hold and are less deadly (V01.1.169, review 27.10. packages 3 and 4, Dominik 2026-10-27 „ok“ with decisions 1 and 2): No new switch, these are rules of the fight. The fight holds: While a fight runs no merchant comes (open_market), the host cannot open the market and nobody buys, sells or has a thing named (hint „First the fight …“, reason markt kampf); a scroll of knowing still works. The flight rolls now count before the map's step, so a successful flight can still lead to a neighbouring place in the same turn; the map thread blocks the change of place in a fight. Boss: A boss counts in the budget with its life factor (dungeon_kampf.wert, faktor, the same number as its life, also for the map's rooms), at most one boss an encounter. A room of the map brings its foes in the number the map sets (raum_gegner.anzahl, at most ANZAHL_MAX, 1 without the field). All down: When in a fight every hero at the table is down or unconscious and one of them lay already, the fight ends in mercy for all: each wakes with 1 life, loses half its gold and one thing, there is no experience (dungeon.down, log „dungeon: zustand | gnade | gruppe | n“). When one lies while others s

text: AI Dungeon Master: nothing breaks any more (V01.1.168, review 27.10. package 1, Dominik 2026-10-27 „ok“): No new switch, these are fixes. Prompt: The style examples of the world and the tone now stand at the very end of the task, after every rule, in their own block between „[Examples]“ and „[End of the examples]“ (dungeon_erzaehler.STIL_BLOCK). Before, the rules for voices, weapons, conditions and the map ran into the last example line without a paragraph and so counted as „only an example“. Every other part of a word still counts („Massenmord“, „splitternackt“), so no real hit is lost. Before, the whole narration failed when the model wrote „Ein Ast knackt“. Outage brake: When no usable narration comes, a fixed sentence stands in the log as a system line, never as a narration the model reads as the story so far in the next turn (dungeon.outage). The next try comes after DM_S (75) seconds at

title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: going to a neighbouring place (V01.1.159, Dominik 2026-10-27, screenshot: „go to the old library“ got a Wisdom check for tracking, the group stayed in the alley): No new switch. When an action names a word of going and exactly one neighbouring place by name or direction („go to the old library“, „I go north-east“), it is a walk (dungeon_karte.asked_ways). Fixed rules: the model's check for that seat goes, unless the action has a risky word (sneak, climb …); the facts name the walk (karte.gewollt) with the task to tell the way and the arrival; when the narration leads elsewhere, the fixed check „gehen“ sends it back once, and when the second try fails too the panel takes the way itself and adds „You set off, your destination: …“. A fight, or foes coming up this turn, holds the group. Also under *Spieler anleiten*: „vague“ now wants at least one point from the panel's data (a person here, a thing near, a foe, a way by its target or direction), the narration's own things alone no longer count („a presence“), and „What you can do here“ shows up to three ways. The dice card no longer shows the receipt number („W-2“), only as a tooltip with real dice; the fixed repair

title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: when a small gesture comes (V01.1.183, LlamaTale idea 7, Dominik 2026-10-27 "1-7"): The gestures of dungeon_nsc.geste now show at the table. On every request of the round the panel checks by a fixed rule (dungeon_warten.geste_faellig, from dungeon.maybe_close): the turn is open, nothing has happened at the table for 2 minutes (GESTE_S; no action, no table talk, no gesture, counted from the turn's start), no fight, no pause, the narrator is not answering, no question for real dice waits, and at most 2 gestures a turn (GESTE_ZUG). Then dungeon_warten.geste writes the line of kind "geste" into the feed (🤲, fields nsc, geste for the gesture's kind, text de and en); nothing else in the round changes. If nobody fits, the time still counts and the next try comes only after another 2 minutes. While a seat plays from the car (dungeon_auto.im_auto) no gesture comes. An error here never breaks the request, it becomes a journal line. Live: gestures, nobody fitting, left out for the car (numbers only); log dungeon: geste | gezeigt, | keine person, | auto, | fehler | kind. Self-tests test_dungeon_gesten.

M3 blessings do not stack: on a value only the highest blessing counts (dungeon.blessing), three times Thorn Vines gives +3 instead of +9, the same blessing again only renews its turns. Concentration: when a hero casts a new spell with a blessing, the hero's last blessing ends on every hero (dungeon._cast, log dungeon: segen | konzentration | N beendet); blessings of other heroes, of potions and altars stay. In a spell attack the spell's bonus counts only as far as it is above the blessing already on the value. 2. M5 armour class and damage: a new helper dungeon.body gives the value as the body has it: the score's bonus and the blessing, less a wound, if asked with the items worn for the value and their effects (never a weapon: its bonus belongs to the weapon's hit and damage, never twice); without abilities and lessons (those still count only for checks, dungeon.total). The armour class takes Dexterity with the items (with the armour's cap), a blessing on Dexterity (Shield, Haste, cat's potion) counts as magic past that cap

text: AI Dungeon Master: content of the D&D ideas 2, 4, 8, 9 and 12 (V01.1.090, Dominik 2026-10-25 "1-12 reihenfolge bestimmst du wie du alles umsetzten kannst."): dungeon_srd.json holds the fixed tables under "ideen", checked by dungeon_ideen.check_rules. All texts are our own, because the templates from the repos (darker-dungeons CC BY-NC-ND, VoloBot and rpg-card without a licence) count only as ideas. Critical tables: 12 rows per damage kind for a d12. Rows 1 to 4 are narration only, the others set an existing condition for 1 to 3 turns, incapacitated, paralysed, stunned and unconscious always for 1 turn only. Fumbles: melee, ranged and spell with 12 mild rows each; a condition only hits the one who fumbles, never a friend. Landscapes: 13, among them "weg" as the fallback and "huegel" and "gras" from the map's terrain, each with the kinds of places it stands for, with night watches on a d20 (quiet, noise, visitor, ambush) and 8 travel events (quiet, rested, hungry, lost, surprised). Campfire: 12 questions for all worlds and 12 each for fantasy, horror, sci-fi and pirates. Travel roles: scout, hunter, watch and pathfinder with a value, names per world and a consequence on failure. Scar

text: AI Dungeon Master: NPC tables, name syllables and oracle in the catalog (V01.1.060, Dominik 2026-10-25, tabletop points 5 and 8, data): 15 fixed tables (tabellen) give randomness by fixed rules: for side characters looks, manner, wish, secret and occupation, for the oracle action, theme, place, descriptor, plot twist, complication, clue, peril, opportunity and settlement trouble. Name syllables (namensilben, not silben: those are the map's place names) per people and for sci-fi and pirates build names from start, middle and end (method like Syllabore, own syllables). The oracle rows and many NPC rows are translated from Datasworn, only from tables under CC-BY-4.0, reworded to be family-friendly. text: AI Dungeon Master: economy part 2 (V01.1.053, Dominik 2026-10-25 "1-12" on the review of the economy, points 3 and 5): Coins: a foe gives the group 5 to 15 gold times the level (before 2 to 10), so coins become the main income. Merchants with a kind: every merchant is a smith (weapons, armour), an alchemist (potions, spells) or a trader (jewellery, tools, scrolls, treasures) (HAENDLER) and sells only its kind. It pays half the worth for its kind, a quarter for anything else and for unknown things (sell_price). Its purse holds 50 gold times the group's level per visit (KASSE); what heroes buy from it fills it again; when it is empty it refuses with its own sentence. The merchant's window names its kind, what it takes for half the worth and the purse. Find table: the rarity of a find comes from a fixed table per level (fundtabelle in the rules, find_row, NIE = never) instead of thresholds plus twice the level. From a foe no rarity from "uncommon" to "epic" gets rarer with the level (before, "rare" fell from 19 to 12 per cent when "epic" came in); legendary things come from level 5 on only from bosses, at most 10 in 100 (before 27), no longer from chests and rewards. text: AI Dungeon Master: faster over the proxy (V01.1.036, Dominik 2026-10-25 "es ist alles langsamer geworden", "ok - alles umsetzten"): A HAR recording over the Synology proxy showed only about 50 to 70 KB per second; the page itself computes as fast as before (a round's view 12 to 13 ms). Hence: Reading aloud as MP3: every piece read aloud is kept as MP3 next to the WAV (48 kbit/s, about a tenth; ffmpeg on the panel computer), the browser fetches the MP3 (?mp3=1, a guest "mp3": true), the iPhone app still the WAV; the next piece loads while the current one plays instead of only after it. Reading counts as speech: while a turn is read aloud, the scene picture, the music and all other background work wait (vorrang), even when the speech output runs on the model computer and the panel does not see its mark. Small pictures: lists (rules, bag, seats) fetch a small copy (96 pixels at most, made once and kept in dungeon-bild-klein, deleted with the picture); only the merchant and the detail window show the large picture. Every picture address carries the picture's version, so the browser keeps it until it is painted again (before, the rules page loaded all 391 pictures again on every visit).

text: AI Dungeon Master: experience for more than fighting (V01.1.030, idea 7 of 2026-10-24, Dominik "alle umsetzen"): The panel gives every hero at the table fixed experience, never the model: for a new place of the map the group enters for the first time ep.ort (10), for an act of the story done (dungeon.step_act, whether the model reports the turning point or the panel moves on) ep.akt (100), and for a fight ended in peace (kampf_ende "frieden") the experience of the foes still standing then, as for defeated ones; that counts only when a check passed in the same turn (persuading, say), otherwise not. A solved riddle of the map gives half of ep.ziel (50) as before. The numbers are in the rules under ep and can be set (ort 0 to 200, akt 0 to 1000, checked by check_rules). The experience gathers like any other as "+X EP still at the table" and comes at the end of the round. Logs dungeon: ep | ort | N, dungeon: ep | akt; the fight line in the log counts frieden. No new endpoint. Self-test Equipment.test_experience_for_more_than_fighting in app/tests/test_dungeon.py.

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: game master dial (V01.1.028, idea 6 of 2026-10-24, Dominik "alle umsetzen"): Own admin switch *Features → AI Dungeon Master → Game master dial* (chat.dungeon_regler, off by default; dungeon_kampf.turn_dial). After every fight, once its last damage is with the heroes, the Spark sets the round's next encounters by fixed numbers: won with less than a quarter of the group's life lost 10 % harder, a hero down, a lost fight or a flight 15 % easier, else it stays; at most 25 % either way, at the children's table never above 0. The dial changes the experience a medium encounter may have (dungeon_kampf.budget), so the offer of foes and the limit of the encounter; the danger ("easy", "medium", "hard") is measured against the dialled value, and the players see only that. The host sees in the game master console the line *🎚 Game master dial* with the setting ("danger +10 %") and *hold*, which keeps it where it is. The setting belongs to the round; switch off means the measured strength without the dial. The model decides none of it. Live counts the day's steps (harder, easier); logs dungeon: regler | hoch | N, runter | N, gleich | N, fest, festgehalten, frei. API (host): POS

text: AI Dungeon Master: balance bench (V01.1.027, idea 5 of 2026-10-24, Dominik "alle umsetzen"): Own admin switch *Features → AI Dungeon Master → Balance bench* (chat.dungeon_pruefstand, off by default; dungeon_pruefstand.py). The Spark plays fights by itself, with the real rules and dice of dungeon_kampf (attacks, the foes' turn, damage, states, flight) and the catalogue including own rules, without the language model and without a round: per level 1 to 10 and group size 1 to 5, 200 fights of danger "medium" each, once a night between 2 and 5 or at once with *Play it through now* (at most once a minute, never two runs at a time). The group is fixed: the classes in turn, the first people, made like a player's hero and raised to the level, the class's first weapon and the best body armour up to the level's price, both of the rarity of a medium find of that level. Each hero drinks its healing potion below a third of its life, otherwise attacks the foe with the least life (a caster with its attack spell of grade 0). The encounter has one or two kinds of foes from the whole bestiary, exactly of the danger asked. Under *Adjust rules* the part *Balance bench* shows the wins per level as bars

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: with the aim of 70 to 90 % as a green band (red outside), plus life lost in won fights and turns, for 1 to 5 heroes. Measured in: the first run showed that a group of four almost always won at "medium", a lone hero only about every second fight. The experience of a medium encounter per hero and level (dungeon_kampf.BUDGET, levels 1 to 10) is now measured with the bench, and it grows with the group (GRUPPE: 0.7 for one hero, 0.33 more for each further one; measured anew with the combat audit V01.1.127, because no attack is lost any more when its foe already fell in the same turn, and with the follow-up check V01.1.130, because heroes drinking a potion or lying on the ground no longer attack with the action of the turn before). A self-test keeps every cell (level and group size) in the aim; whoever changes foes or weapons sees it there. In the real game abilities and healing spells help too, which the bench does not use. No fight of the bench counts into the day's numbers, no round is touched. The result is in dungeon-pruefstand.json in the state folder. Live: cells, below and above the aim, whether it is playing. Logs dungeon: pruefstand | start | nacht (or knopf), fertig | N zelle

text: AI Dungeon Master: fight part 2 (V01.1.026, bestiary points 4 to 6 and item point 2, Dominik 2026-10-24 "alles nach empfehlung umsetzten"): Weapon properties: every weapon carries a damage kind (schaden_art: slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, for wands force, radiant or necrotic) and properties (eigenschaften), each a fixed rule of the panel (dungeon_kampf.EIGENSCHAFT_REGEL): light is critical from a 19, finesse hits with the better of Strength and Dexterity, a throw (the action says "throw", fixed words WURF_WORTE) too, heavy attacks at a disadvantage below Strength 13, versatile rolls a die two sides bigger with the off hand free, reach keeps the foe it hit at a distance (its attack on that hero in the same turn at a disadvantage). The item shows kind and rules as a line of its own. Damage kinds: every hit has a kind (weapon, spell, fists = bludgeoning). A foe with resistenz takes half the damage, with immun none, with schwaeche double; the log shows the kind and "halved", "no effect" or "double!", the foe's window shows what it is weak against or protected from. States from hits: when a foe with zustaende (poisoned, grappled, frightened, burning …) hits, the hero rolls a save with

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: Constitution (Wisdom against charmed and frightened) against 10 + a quarter of the foe's level. Failed, the state lasts its turns from the catalogue and works by fixed rules: disadvantage on own attacks or checks, advantage for the foes, no attack (paralysed, stunned …), burning or bleeding costs 1d4 life each turn. All states end with the fight. The seat shows them with ☠, the log every save, the model gets them in the facts. Bosses: a foe with boss has more life per hero (+50 % for each further one), a second phase from half life (+2 to hit, a line in the log), attacks twice a turn and leaves a better find (occasion "boss"). text: AI Dungeon Master: six values as in D&D (V01.0.958, Dominik 2026-10-23 "die werte der helden können wir diese erweitern wie bei dungeon and dragons", "ok" = recommendations 2a and 3a): instead of strength, dexterity and wits every hero has Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma (werte, exactly six, konstitution among them). Each value is a score as in D&D, the bonus for rolls follows from it: (score − 10) / 2 rounded down, so 8 gives −1, 10 gives 0, 16 gives +3 (mod). The panel rolls d20 plus that bonus plus equipment, abilities and blessings. When creating a hero the player lays out the fixed row 15, 14, 13, 12, 10 and 8 (verteilung) on the six values: drag numbers, or tap two to swap them, preset by the class's reihe (warrior strength first, mage intelligence, rogue dexterity, healer wisdom, ranger dexterity); the panel takes only exactly that row, otherwise the class's order counts. The people add +1 or +2 (human +1 everywhere, dwarf constitution +2 and wisdom +1, elf dexterity +2 and intelligence +1, halfling dexterity +2 and charisma +1, orc strength +2 and constitution +1, each 0 to 2). text: AI Dungeon Master: better stories (V01.0.971, plan dungeon-master/plan.md section "Bessere Geschichten – Bauplan", Dominik 2026-10-23 "1-6"): Six parts make the narration denser and more varied, all without a switch, because they only concern the own language model. World truth: Before the prologue the model writes a hidden truth once per round (3 to 6 people with role, goal and way of speaking, up to 3 groups and 3 secrets); the panel checks it (fixed lengths, no hero names, no doubles, word list) and gives it to every turn as facts. New people from narrations are added (at most 12). Only the host sees it at the table under "Truth of this chapter". Open threads: With each narration the model reports new tasks, promises or riddles (at most 2) and finished ones (only open threads can be closed); at most 8 stand in the side column under "Open threads". Running summary: Every 5 turns the model sums up the round in at most 900 characters; after that each turn gets only the summary and the last two narrations instead of a long list. Rewrite: The panel checks every narration with fixed rules: too short (under 80 characters), a hero with an action is missing from the text, or it repeats t

The panel rolled the number before, the tap only shows it (rd["wurf_offen"] with seat, check and turn, never the number in the view). When an own die appears, a soft chime sounds once. With "reduce motion" the number shows at once. Everything is drawn in the browser, no library and no files.

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: life 0 has consequences, powers work by fixed rules, experience only at the end (V01.1.008, points 1 and 3 of the review of 2026-10-24, Dominik "alles umsetzten", "1" with permadeath, "nur ohnmächtig" at the children's table): At 0 life a hero is down: it does not act, the turn does not wait for it, and bag, sheet and trading are locked (reason "boden"). A friend gives it one of their own healing potions with "🧪 Give a healing potion" on its card, a healing spell for the group gets it up, or the narration reports healing when someone helps it up in their action. After 3 told turns without healing (BODEN_ZUEGE) it has fallen, for good: everything it wore and carried and its gold lie under "Lying here" for the others, the experience of this table is gone. A fallen hero stays so in the profile's hero list, in the guest account and in a campaign; it sits at no table again (reason "tot"), gets no hero code and no more consequences. For a new hero the host takes the seat back and invites again. When everyone is down, the Dungeon Master narrates on once the turn time is up. At the children's table (the youngest tone) nobody dies: after the 3 turns the hero is only uncon

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: AI Dungeon Master: every character in its clone voice with a Base model (V01.1.007, points 16.2 and 17.3 of the review of 2026-10-24, Dominik "Beides, je nach Modell"): when the speech output runs a Base model (Settings → Speech output, model "…-Base") and VoiceDesign is provided as well, a character's first sentence (narrator, NPC or hero with a described voice) is spoken with VoiceDesign as before and then kept as its clone reference if it is 3 to 15 seconds long. Every later sentence of that character is spoken by the Base model from the reference: the same sound in every turn and faster than VoiceDesign. If that fails twice VoiceDesign steps in, then the fixed voice. The references live in the state folder dungeon-klone (at most 200, the longest unused go first) and count for all rounds, so a character with the same description sounds the same in the next round too. With the preset CustomVoice model nothing changes. The Live overview counts the clone voices, the log writes dungeon: vorlesen | klon | neu | 5.0 s. The own music model (Making music, musik.make) builds one shared store for the whole Spark, one field per world and mood: exploring, tavern, tension, fight, finale, victory and vault. Each field holds as many pieces as the admin sets (default 12, 4 to 30). A piece runs 3 to 6 minutes, a victory 30 s, all instrumental. Each piece has its own seed and a way of playing from fixed lists of the world (instruments, tempo, key). Fitting the theme (V01.1.017, Dominik 2026-10-24 "more to do with the themes … drums and basses welcome", after 2026-10-23 "nothing annoying or too fast"): every world has its own scene and instruments per mood, for example a fantasy tavern with lute, fiddle, frame drum and upright bass, a fantasy fight with w

head: Voice chat
title: Voice chat
text: ar drums, deep bass and horns, a pirate fight with barrel drums, horror tension with a heartbeat bass. Drums and bass are everywhere, but with measure and never hectic: exploring 70 to 80, tavern 90 to 100, tension 65 to 80, fight 95 to 110, finale 85 to 100, vault 60 to 72 beats per minute. Longer and soft (V01.1.042, Dominik 2026-10-25 "at least triple the length", "smooth transition … maybe the same chord progression"): a piece now runs 3 to 6 minutes (a victory stays short). Every field has a fixed tempo (exploring 75, tavern 96, tension 72, fight 100, finale 92, victory 96, vault 66 beats per minute) and every world a fixed key (fantasy D minor, horror C minor, sci-fi A minor, pirates E minor; tavern and victory in the relative major), so pieces of the same mood following each other fit together harmonically. Every piece starts softly and fades out long, the crossfade takes 12 s. Because the pieces are longer, a round orders 2 instead of 4 pieces per field ahead, and the storage defaults to 2000 MB; if the set storage is too small for the number of pieces, the card "Music at the table" says so. Older pieces keep playing until their field has new ones. Pieces of an older style

The panel picks the mood: fight (a fight at the table or fight words in the scene), then vault (the group stands in a random vault of the map), then a merchant or a settlement (tavern), then the story's last act (finale), then tension words in the scene, else the act's mood (word list over title, content and turning point; act 1 exploring, then tension). Ahead: every running round asks for 2 pieces each for the mood now, the act's, the next act's, fight and victory. Every new act orders 2 new pieces for the act after it, which replace the most played ones, so campaigns do not sound alike. At night (1 to 6 o'clock, not during a Notaus) and with "Prepare music now" the Spark fills every field up to the number. Only one piece is made at a time, on the place of the heavy jobs (schwer.run("musik")), with speech first, and only while no other heavy job waits. After
