text: - Control centre on the screen (Features → Access → "Control centre on the screen"): A screen on the panel computer's HDMI output shows the control centre: state and the day's numbers on top, in the middle which request runs through which stage right now and on which computer (with Spark split tars and the Pi with CPU, G …

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Switch models (Features → Access → "Switch models"): Under Status → Models an admin switches the model of a kind: language model, image understanding, speech recognition, speech output or painting pictures.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Own models (Features → Access → "Own models"; builds on "Switch models"): Under Status → Models an admin adds a model from Hugging Face, for the language model or image understanding.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Workshop (Features → Access → "Workshop"): On the page Status → Workshop an admin lets the model computer work in a sealed-off copy of the code.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Test every night (Features → Access → "Test every night"; builds on "Workshop"): Once a night the workshop starts the test run by itself (all self-tests as on GitHub, without a language model).

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Remote access to servers (Features → Access → "Remote access to servers"): The shell of a server elsewhere (a VPS, a NAS at friends', a Raspberry Pi) right in the browser, like Raspberry Pi Connect, only the relay is your own Pi.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Note on a remote session (Features → Access → "Note on a remote session"; builds on "Remote access to servers"): When an admin opens the shell of a server from the internet or from a place they never opened it from, all admins get a note on their phone with a fixed text: who, which server, home or internet, never an address.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Spontaneous help (Features → Access → "Spontaneous help"; builds on "Remote access to servers"): Help once, like TeamViewer QuickSupport: the person opens the page /hilfe of your panel, types the 6-digit number and her first name and shares her screen after you accept.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Assistant in remote access (Features → Access → "Assistant in remote access"; builds on "Remote access to servers"): Beside the terminal under Remote access → Systems there is "Ask the assistant": you ask e.g.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Screen in remote access (Features → Access → "Screen in remote access"; builds on "Remote access to servers"): The screen of a paired system in the browser, under Remote access → Systems with "Screen": Linux with X11 (x11vnc), GNOME on Wayland (gnome-remote-desktop) or other Wayland desktops (wayvnc) and macOS (the built-in screen sharing).

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Clipboard with the screen (Features → Access → "Clipboard with the screen"; builds on "Screen in remote access"): Exchange text between your browser and the system while you have "Control": what you copy there lands in your clipboard; "Send clipboard" sends yours over.

head: Access
title: Access
text: - Attack probe (Features → Access → "Attack probe"; builds on "Workshop"): Measures on a button how often the running language model would follow an order in outside text (document, mail, web page, calendar, smart home). <!-- /funktionen:liste -->

head: Installation in detail
title: Installation in detail
text: Split install (the panel on a computer of its own such as a Raspberry Pi 5), moving and taking back: Spark split.

head: Only the models (without the web panel)
title: Only the models (without the web panel)
text: 1. Complete: models, APIs and the web panel with the assistant (as before). 2. Only the models with their APIs: for other services (Open WebUI, your own apps, Home Assistant …), without web panel, password and certificate.

head: Only the models (without the web panel)
title: Only the models (without the web panel)
text: Then it asks which models (speech recognition Qwen3-ASR 1.7B, 0.6B, Parakeet or none; speech output Qwen3-TTS 0.6B, 1.7B or none; VoiceDesign yes or no, each with a rough memory estimate) and whether the APIs should be reachable from the network or only on the Spark itself (127.0.0.1, e.g. behind your own reverse proxy). An API key is always generated and required. Later runs and updates do not ask again. Without questions:

head: Only the models (without the web panel)
title: Only the models (without the web panel)
text: At the end the addresses, the key and ready-made curl examples are printed and kept in /etc/speech-spark/connection.txt (readable by root only). Without the panel, the speech-spark command does its jobs:

head: Only the models (without the web panel)
title: Only the models (without the web panel)
text: The watchdog for hung services, which otherwise runs in the panel, runs as speech-spark-watch with the same rules. After an update, TTS speaks a sentence and ASR has to understand it; if that fails, the update puts the previous version back. The self-tests run before every update in both modes. If the language model still comes from dgx-spark-qwen38, it is not touched; the own language model is updated along. If Open WebUI runs in Docker on the same Spark, the APIs have to be reachable from the network (127.0.0.1 inside the container is the container itself).

head: Updating
title: Updating
text: In the panel under System you see the installed version and, when GitHub has a newer one, the list of changes. Update installieren (install update) fetches and installs it. Settings, models and voices are kept, and the log streams live. Update abbrechen cancels a running update. Packages that are already installed are not upgraded; only what the new version needs is added. The self-test runs before the new version goes live. If it or an earlier step (download, packages) fails, the update stops and the services keep running the old version unchanged. If something fails after the switch, update.sh installs the previous version again and says so in the log. While the update runs, a progress window locks the panel (other tabs and phones too: the server refuses changes, the assistant keeps answering); question, progress and restart stand in this one window: behind it the page keeps still (no band "The Spark is not answering", no version bar), the bar only moves forward, and the window waits calmly across the panel restart. At the end the page loads once and comes back to the same place (Settings → Update). Each state shows only its own buttons: the question Install and Cancel, a running

head: Updating
title: Updating
text: update none; after 45 minutes without finishing it offers Reload and Cancel update, a failed one Close and Copy log. The log stays folded below. The lock begins with the click on Install (since V01.0.878, update.begin): the server holds it itself while it backs up first, and every page, the iPhone app, Live and the case's display show the same steps: "Sicherung vor dem Update" (backup), "Update startet", "Lädt und prüft die neue Version" (fetch and check), "Neue Version geladen", on a shared Spark "Modell-Rechner wird zuerst aktualisiert" (model computer first), then the install steps up to restarting the services and "Fertig". Every end, early ones included (GitHub not reachable, no tested version, wrong signature, the unit does not start), writes done with its reason; that ends the lock and the window names the reason. A second start during the lock is refused. The Spark companion on PC and Mac shows the same line "Spark-Update läuft: 40 % · step" in its state and during the restart "Spark startet für das Update neu …" instead of "not reachable" (since V01.0.883, begleiter.spark_update in /api/desk/poll, needs the new companion build).

head: Updating
title: What's new (changelog)
text: What's new (changelog): every change up to the installed version, one line per version, newest first, with a search. Open it with "Was ist neu" (What's new) at the bottom next to the version number or under *Settings → Update und Sicherung (update and backup) → Was ist neu (Changelog) → View*. The admin and every profile in its own browser login can see it (not guests, not device keys). Versions newer than at the last opening in this browser carry "new". The list comes from CHANGELOG.md of the installed version (the update puts a copy into app/).

head: Updating
title: Updating
text: The installer keeps its own git checkout in /opt/speech-spark/src, so it no longer matters where you cloned the repo originally.

head: Updating
title: Once, for installs from before the update button
text: Once, for installs from before the update button: run git pull and sudo ./install.sh in the cloned repo. After that the button works.

head: Updating
title: Updating
text: Running the script again updates the code and adds what is missing to the Python environments; packages already installed stay as they are. The existing configuration is kept and new settings are added.

head: Painting pictures (optional)
title: Painting pictures (optional)
text: With --bild the installation also installs the picture model FLUX.2 [klein] (only with the web panel; the first install asks, the default is none, sudo speech-spark models asks again):

head: Painting pictures (optional)
title: Own language model (preparation, since V01.0.590)
text: Own language model (preparation, since V01.0.590): sudo ./install.sh --llm creates venv-llm with vLLM for the own language model, sudo ./install.sh --kolibri also venv-kolibri (vLLM 0.29 with Aleph Alpha's plugin, pinned by its hash). Both stay current with every update. The services speech-spark-llm, speech-spark-llmtor and speech-spark-sehen are set up but only run once sudo speech-spark modelle llm uebernehmen (stage E3) switches the own model on; until then qwen38 stays the language model. Logs: sudo speech-spark logs llm, llmtor, sehen.

head: Painting pictures (optional)
title: Painting pictures (optional)
text: It builds stable-diffusion.cpp once (sd-server, pinned commit, CUDA for the GB10, needs nvcc and cmake) into /opt/speech-spark/sdcpp, downloads the model files with a SHA-256 check into /var/lib/speech-spark/models/bild and sets up the service speech-spark-bild (only 127.0.0.1, ports image.port 31005 and image.engine_port 31015). The model takes memory only while painting. Then switch on Features → Painting pictures in the panel and press "Bild testen". Details: Assistant.

head: Making music (optional)
title: Making music (optional)
text: With --musik the installation also installs the music model ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT licence; on the model computer, with a split install together with --teilen; the first install asks, the default is none, sudo speech-spark models asks again):

head: Making music (optional)
title: Making music (optional)
text: It builds acestep.cpp once (ace-server, pinned commit, ggml linked in, CUDA for the GB10, no torch and no Docker, needs nvcc and cmake) into /opt/speech-spark/acestep, downloads the GGUF files with a SHA-256 check into /var/lib/speech-spark/models/musik and sets up the service speech-spark-musik (only 127.0.0.1, with a split install through the TLS-Tor; ports music.port 31004 and music.engine_port 31014). The engine loads only for a song and frees the memory after 10 minutes without one; without enough free memory it does not load. Several models can be installed one after the other; all files stay. State → Checks → "Test music" measures every installed model with two fixed samples (30 s of piano, 60 s with German vocals) and shows time, memory and the samples to listen to. Then switch on Features → Making music and pick the model there; every released profile then makes songs in the conversation and under Me → Music. Logs: sudo speech-spark logs musik, maintenance pause: sudo speech-spark pause musik 30.

head: Making music (optional)
title: Making music (optional)
text: With --werkstatt (on the model computer) the workshop comes along: OpenCode as one file from the npm registry, version and SHA-512 fixed in app/werkstatt.py, into /opt/speech-spark/werkstatt; plus the user spark-werkstatt with the folder /var/lib/spark-werkstatt/arbeit and the unit speech-spark-werkstatt. Without the option nothing of it is fetched; once there, an update keeps it. Then switch on Features → Workshop.

head: Making music (optional)
title: Making music (optional)
text: With --fernbild (on the computer with the panel) guacd for the screen in Remote access comes along: the distribution's packages guacd, libguac-client-vnc0 and libguac-client-rdp0 (tested with 1.3 to 1.5, security updates come with apt), their own unit guacd.service stays masked; only the unit speech-spark-guacd runs, on 127.0.0.1:4822, started by the panel when a screen opens. Once there, an update keeps it. Then switch on Features → Remote access to servers → Screen and run sudo spark-anker bildschirm once on the system.

head: Uninstalling
title: Uninstalling
text: dgx-spark-qwen38 is not touched; the own language model (venv-llm) goes with uninstall.sh.

head: iPhone app "Spark"
title: iPhone app "Spark"
text: An own app for the iPhone (source in ios/): press the button, ask, the answer comes in the Spark voice, also with the screen locked. "Hey Siri, Ask Spark" (German phrase "Frag Spark") runs through the app without a shortcut, also with AirPods and through Siri in the car. Since V01.0.676 the app has its own CarPlay icon in the car (Apple granted the entitlement).

head: Switch it on in the panel
title: Switch it on in the panel
text: 1. Admin: Features → iPhone app on, save. 2. This works at once for every profile. Only the admin blocks single profiles (People and devices → Blocked functions). 3. To switch lights and devices from the app: "Smart home from the app" on. The code word applies as everywhere. 4. For the wake word and stand mode: "Allow listening all the time" on. 5. To start routes and calls by voice: "Routes and calls on the iPhone" on. 6. Notes on its own (morning briefing, reminders) come from the start; they can be switched off under Me → By itself. Reminders and timers ring as iPhone notifications, also with the app closed.

head: Getting the app onto the iPhone (on a Mac, about 15 minutes once)
title: Getting the app onto the iPhone (on a Mac, about 15 minutes once)
text: 1. Install Xcode from the Mac App Store (free) and open it once. 2. Xcode → Settings → Accounts → + → sign in with your Apple ID. A free account is enough to try it; the app then runs for 7 days and has to be installed again. With the Apple Developer Program (99 €/year) it runs for a year and works with TestFlight. 3. Get the repo: git clone https://github.com/db9979/speech-on-dgx-spark.git (or git pull). 4. Double-click ios/Spark.xcodeproj. 5. Click the project Spark → target Spark → Signing & Capabilities → pick your account as Team. Do the same for the second target SparkNotify (it fetches the text of push notifications). If Xcode says the bundle ID is taken: project Spark (not the target) → Build Settings → search APP_BUNDLE_ID and add something of your own; both targets take it over. 6. Connect the iPhone by cable, unlock it, confirm "Trust This Computer". 7. On the iPhone: Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode on (the iPhone restarts). 8. In Xcode pick your iPhone as the destination at the top, then press ▶︎ (Run). 9. On first start the iPhone says "Untrusted Developer": Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → your Apple ID → Trust. Then open the app.

head: Pairing
title: Pairing
text: 1. In the panel Me → iPhone app → "Pair an iPhone". 2. On a PC: scan the QR code with the iPhone camera. On the iPhone: tap "open in the app". 3. The app asks "Pair with this Spark?" and shows the address. Tap Pair only for your own address.

head: Pairing
title: Pairing
text: The link is valid for 10 minutes and once. The address must be https with a real certificate (your reverse proxy); the self-signed certificate on port 31443 is not accepted. If you open the panel for pairing through port 31443 or an IP address, the panel says so right under the QR code. If the iPhone later does not accept the certificate, the app names the address and the reverse proxy in the "Spark not reachable" note: after the panel moves (e.g. to the Raspberry Pi) the reverse proxy must point to the new computer; the app keeps its address and its key.

head: Pairing
title: With an invitation
text: With an invitation (since V01.0.276): when someone without a profile opens the invitation link on the iPhone and taps "Rather straight in the iPhone app", the app creates the profile with name and PIN and is paired right away. The app shows the Spark's address first. An app that is already paired takes no invitation (unpair first); PIN links work only in the browser.

head: Pairing
title: With a review code
text: With a review code (since V01.0.754, for Apple's App Store review): the admin switches on Features → Review access for the iPhone app, picks a profile under People and devices → Review access for the iPhone app (best one of its own such as "App Review", never one with an admin role) and taps "Make a review access". The panel shows the https address and a code of twelve letters and digits (ABCD-EFGH-JKMN, without 0/O and 1/I/L) once; only its hash is stored. In the app type both under Connect with a review code (case, spaces and dashes do not matter); the app asks "Pair with this Spark?" as with a link. The code is valid 14 days for at most 5 iPhones, at most 3 review accesses at a time. Wrong codes count like wrong PINs: after several the address is locked for a while. While a profile has a review access, smart home, mail, calendars, contacts, calls, chats, Telegram, jobs, MCP, speakers, room mode, announcements, phone, companion, Spark update, reports, NAS, storage and reMarkable are blocked for it, whatever else is on. Deleting the review access removes the iPhones paired with it at once; after 14 days this happens by itself.

head: Pairing
title: Look without a Spark
text: Look without a Spark (since V01.0.754): at the bottom of the pairing screen the app shows a demo with examples, without pairing and without network. The app answers typed questions itself with fixed examples; speaking does not work there (speech recognition runs on the Spark). End the demo at the top left goes back to pairing.

head: Using it
title: Using it
text: - The assistant's face at the top is the same as in the panel (robot, comic or comic woman; since V01.0.521 you pick it yourself at the top of Settings → *Face* in the app or in the panel under Me → Conversation, else the admin's default applies; the app takes it over when it opens and after the pick, with the next TestFlight build). It blinks, looks around, listens with a red antenna, thinks with a turning arc and moves its mouth while speaking. Tapping it works like the button. With "Face shows what it does" on in the panel (V01.0.323), the app's face shows the same as the panel: a magnifier while searching, a calendar sheet, a letter, a light bulb for the smart home, a note pad when remembering, think bubbles, a tick with a wink after something was done, a question mark on an error and "zzz" after 5 quiet minutes. Driven only by the Spark's events, never by the answer's text. - Big button: tap, speak; the app notices when you are done (or tap again). Tapping while the Spark speaks stops it. - Questions can also be typed. Top left starts a new conversation; after 10 minutes of quiet it starts anew by itself. - "Hey Siri, Frag Spark" (or "Hey Siri, Spark fragen"): Siri asks for th

head: Using it
title: Using it
text: e question and reads the answer aloud.

head: Using it
title: Using it
text: Routes and calls: "Navigiere zur Arbeit" or "Ruf Anna an". The app asks every time ("Open route to …?", "Call Anna (number)?"). Only "Ja" (tapped or said) opens Maps or calls. Contacts are searched only on the iPhone; the number does not go to the Spark.

head: Quick start, history, photos, offline
title: Quick start, history, photos, offline
text: - Quick start: "Talk to Spark" opens the app and it listens at once. On the Action button: iPhone Settings → Action Button → Shortcut → "Talk to Spark". In Control Center (iOS 18 and later) via "Add a Control", on the lock screen as a widget. With Siri: "Hey Siri, Start Spark". - History: The clock icon at the top left shows your earlier conversations, the same list as the panel's log. Tapping one continues it. Deleting stays in the panel. - Today (since V01.0.286): the sun at the top right shows what is due today, like *Me → Overview* in the panel: next appointments of today and tomorrow, open reminders, unread messages, documents, remembered facts. Only cards of functions your profile may use; pull down to refresh. - Ask about a photo or document: The paper clip next to the input: take a photo, choose a photo, or a document (PDF, text, image). The iPhone reads the text itself, scanned pages too. Only the text goes to the Spark. The attachment stays for the conversation until you remove it with ✕. Let the Spark look at photos: with "Let the model look at photos from the app" on under Me → iPhone app (plus the admin switch for pictures), a photo goes to the Spark as a picture, scal

head: Quick start, history, photos, offline
title: Quick start, history, photos, offline
text: ed to 1280 px, so it also recognises things, plants or an error display. Follow-up questions about the same photo work for 10 minutes. With it off, the iPhone reads only the text as before. PDFs and documents always stay text. - Save to "My things": With own documents released for your profile, the attachment shows a button for it. The Spark then finds the document later, like an upload in the panel. Since V01.0.723 there is no profile switch for it any more. - Offline: When the Spark cannot be reached, the app says so at the top. Typed questions wait (at most 10, for one day) and go out once the Spark is back. Speaking does not work then, because the Spark recognises the speech. - Calm, nothing jumps (since V01.0.570): the note "Spark not reachable" comes only after 3 seconds without the Spark, so a short network change or the restart during an update does not make it blink. When messages arrive from another device, the app only appends the new ones; the history is not drawn anew. An open page under Settings stays open even when the admin blocks it right then (with a note on top; Back closes it). Monitoring and Checks show an error only on the second failed try and at the end of t

head: Quick start, history, photos, offline
title: Quick start, history, photos, offline
text: he list, rows in Logs and hints keep their place. With the charger, the history stays in place behind the stand view. - Last state at once (since V01.0.748, function "Apps keep the last state"): history, chats, My profile, settings and "Open in the panel" show the state of last time as soon as they open, with "As of 16:05 · refreshing …" on top until the Spark has answered (then the note goes, or it says "Spark not reachable right now"). Kept are the 20 newest conversations with 50 messages each, the chat list and the last page of up to 20 chats, the own settings and functions and the numbers on the tiles of "My things" (only how many, no name); private chats and chats with "messages vanish" never. Without a kept state the page shows grey placeholders, after a second "Connecting to the Spark …", after 8 seconds "This takes longer than usual …" and on an error "Try again". When the app comes to the front it fetches history, chats and settings once in the background (at most every 5 minutes). When a page needs more than 2 seconds, Status → Logs (area Apps) shows a line app: langsam <page> <ms> ms iphone. - Save the battery (since V01.0.668): in the background the app stops its audio

head: Quick start, history, photos, offline
title: Quick start, history, photos, offline
text: engine as soon as nothing listens, speaks or calls any more; an answer still playing is finished first. iOS can then put the app to sleep. Exception: the wake word listens (on the charger, or for the time under "On battery"). In the car the app lets go of the sound after every conversation since V01.0.871, also in front, so radio and music do not stay quieter. - English: On an iPhone set to English the app is in English, including the wake word and Siri ("Ask Spark", "Start Spark"). - Long questions (since V01.0.829): the input field grows up to five lines, beyond that it scrolls. The return key makes a new line, the arrow sends. From four lines ⤢ at the top right of the field opens the large view over the whole screen: *Done* puts the text back into the field, *Send* sends it.

head: My profile
title: My profile
text: In the app under Settings → My profile you set the same values as in the panel; changes apply on both sides at once:

head: My profile
title: My profile
text: - Voice: voice and speaking speed, with "Listen to a sample". - Answers: answer length. Your wishes for the tone are only shown; they change in the panel, because the language model is told them. - By itself: on/off, quiet time, at most so many notes a day, appointments with lead time, weather with place and time, parcels, birthdays, bus and train, greeting, mails, morning briefing with time. Shown only when the admin has "By itself" on. Topics whose service is off in the profile are greyed out. - What the app may do: shown only. Change it in the panel under Me → iPhone app.

head: Reminders, sharing, Shortcuts
title: Reminders, sharing, Shortcuts
text: - Apple Reminders: With "Apple Reminders on the iPhone" (Me → iPhone app, off) the app asks after each Spark reminder "… also put into the Reminders app?". After "yes" it is in the list "Spark", without its own alarm (the Spark rings already). When the Spark cancels a reminder it goes there too. New shopping and to-do entries come into the lists "Shopping" and "To-dos" when the app opens (each entry once). A list kept in a CalDAV account stays there. - Share → Spark: In Safari, Mail, Files or Photos tap Share → Spark. Text, web page (the iPhone loads it itself), PDF or photo: the iPhone reads the text (a photo goes as a picture with the photo switch on), then you ask about it or store it under "My documents" (with the documents switch). The answer can be shared, e.g. as a note. - Shortcuts: The Shortcuts app gets "Ask Spark", "Reminder at the Spark", "Add to a Spark list" and "Store a document at the Spark". Lists need the reminders switch, documents the documents switch. - Notes: Apple does not let apps write into Notes directly. Two ways: long-press an answer in the app → "Share (e.g. as a note)", or a shortcut of "Ask Spark" plus Apple's "Create Note".

head: Panel areas in the app
title: Panel areas in the app
text: The app takes over the panel bit by bit (plan "iPhone app takes over the panel"). The admin switches on "Panel areas in the iPhone app" under Features; that applies at once to every profile with a paired iPhone, only the admin blocks single profiles (People and devices → Blocked functions). The former switches per area under Me → iPhone app are gone since the app parity (Dominik 2026-10-14). Everything starts off, guests get none of it. The app itself cannot switch an area on.

head: Panel areas in the app
title: Panel areas in the app
text: - Open in the panel (Settings): whatever the app does not show itself opens the panel right here in the app at the right place (the first time you sign in as in the browser). The list shows every page of Me your profile can use now, reMarkable, storage, writing help, companion and MCP too; it comes from the Spark (/api/features, list pages from features.ME_PAGES), so a new page shows up without an app update. Only overview, let's go, sign in and Android app are left out, with a reason (features.APP_SKIP). With "Manage the Spark" also monitoring, logs, features and profiles. - Features and People and devices under Manage the Spark (since V01.0.276): the names and groups of the switches come from the Spark, the app keeps no list of its own. A profile also shows its functions "n of m on" to switch, its admin role and the signed-in browsers (swipe to sign out). - My day: the next appointments of your calendars and the Spark's reminders (swipe to delete). Under My profile the conversation switches join: learn from conversations, a new conversation every day and, when the admin allows them, learn from corrections, think when choosing tools and targeted tool choice. Since V01.0.723 the me

head: Panel areas in the app
title: Panel areas in the app
text: mory is under My things. - Manage the Spark (only for profiles with the Admin or Manager role): after Face ID the app counts the way your profile is signed in, without an admin sign-in of its own (since V01.0.541). The app key only counts if it was created after your second login step was switched on; the panel password works only in the browser. Inside: Summary ("Needs you", memory, CPU/GPU, services), Logs (diagnosis as in the panel with areas and time span, "Copy for thread" and share), Checks (function check, quality test, priority check) and Workshop (since V01.0.886, admin only: the workshop's results, newest first, each with what it means and the next step; looking into a cause and repairing open the panel's page Status → Workshop in the app). Under Change: Remote access (since V01.1.213, admin only: the paired remote servers with their state, Disconnect, Disconnect all, May connect and Remove; shell and pairing open the panel's page Remote access → Systems in the app), Features (the plain on/off switches; sensitive ones like "Port", the second login step for profiles and the iPhone switches themselves stay in the browser), People and devices (create a profile, remove device

head: Panel areas in the app
title: Panel areas in the app
text: s, new PIN, reset the second step, delete a profile; a code only at "change protection") and Backups (back up now; deleting old ones only as admin; restoring and downloading in the browser). A manager sees only the summary, logs and people and devices; there they lift a profile's blocks but switch no function and block nothing (only the admin does, since V01.0.551). - Teach your voice: the app shows three sentences, you read them aloud, saving needs the code from the authenticator app. Below, "Teach" for each of your speakers (the speaker then asks for five sentences). Needs speaker recognition from the admin and your profile's second login step. - Proactive: weather place, parcels from e-mails, bus and train (search and set a stop), look at and stop your jobs, room mode "+30 min" (at most four hours from now). The switches weather, parcels, bus and train and jobs are here too. - Security: your devices (swipe to remove), recent logins, log out everywhere, turn the second step off or new recovery codes (with a code). Setting it up works only in the browser with the PIN: otherwise someone with your unlocked iPhone alone could set their own second step. - Connect accounts: mail, calen

head: Panel areas in the app
title: Panel areas in the app
text: dar, contacts, smart home and Telegram. Only with your profile's second login step and a fresh code. The Spark checks the connection, stores password or token encrypted and never hands it out; the iPhone does not keep it.

head: My things
title: My things
text: Since V01.0.723 (Dominik 2026-10-17, plan app-meine-sachen/plan.md) everything the Spark keeps for you is on one page: the icon with four squares at the top left beside the conversation, or Settings → My things. Tiles with their numbers show Documents, Made by the Spark, Pictures, Music and Memory, below them "Recently added". The search at the top covers everything: titles, file names, senders, tags, picture wishes, songs and remembered facts (it runs on the iPhone, nothing goes to the Spark for it).

head: My things
title: My things
text: Each tile follows only the admin's release of its function (Own documents, Creating documents, Painting pictures, Making music, Memory), without a profile switch and without the switch "Panel areas in the iPhone app". When the admin blocks a function for your profile, its tile goes away and the app's key no longer reaches its paths (iphone.THINGS). Guests get none of it.

head: My things
title: My things
text: - Documents: one row per document with the title from the profile card, below it kind, sender and source, on the right the date and a mark only when something matters (deadline, being read, not readable, for everyone, search off). Quick filters with their numbers (All, Deadline open, Being read, For everyone, Search off, Not readable), plus sort (newest, name, deadline, size), source and tag in the filter menu; the app remembers sort and source. With "Newest first" the documents stand in groups: This week, This month, Older. The search finds titles, senders and tags at once, Enter also searches the content ("Found in the content"). "Select" marks several: delete (with a question first), for everyone, only for me, searching on or off, read again (at most 20), through POST /api/profile/wissen/batch. A tap opens the document's page: profile card, "Original and text" (a kept PDF or picture in Apple's preview, beside it the stored text, long texts in parts with "Read on"), tap a tag to remove it and type new ones, "Assistant searches it", "For everyone", remind of the deadline, read again and delete. At the bottom "Switches for documents" with the switches of Me → Documents, as far as t

head: My things
title: My things
text: he admin allows them, and "Left-out folders" (since V01.0.778): the list of folders and names the Spark never reads, with "Let in again", adding name rules (asking first how many documents leave the search) and removing them with a swipe; leaving out a single folder happens in the folder tree in the panel. - Knowledge book (since V01.0.787, plan *wissensbuch* stage E, only when the admin released the knowledge book): below Documents the row "Knowledge book" with the pages by kind, on top contradictions ("Right" keeps one value) and out-of-date sentences ("Still right", "Wrong"). A page shows every sentence with its source; swiping left is "Wrong". "Load as an Obsidian folder" fetches the book as a ZIP to share. In the conversation, an answer from at least two sources shows "To the knowledge book"; only your tap files it. Writing a page again and deleting pages stay in the panel under Me → Documents → Knowledge book. Android shows all of it through the panel view. - Knowledge map (since V01.0.894, plan *wissensgraph* stage 1, only when the admin released the knowledge map): in the knowledge book "Map" on top and "On the map" on every page. The app draws the points itself (the page i

head: My things
title: My things
text: n the middle, its neighbours in a ring, the rest outside, causes as dashed red lines); a tap shows the point's connections with their source, "To the middle" takes it as the middle, swipe left for "Wrong". "All" shows the best connected points again. The Spark checks every change (iphone.THINGS "wissenskarte"); the export stays in the browser. - Made by the Spark: the documents the Spark made, as before. - Pictures: all painted pictures as a grid; a tap shows one large with wish and time, share and delete. At the top a field "What shall I paint?"; while painting, the app looks again every 4 seconds. Changing, quick buttons and own photos stay in the panel under Me → Pictures. - Music: all songs grouped by day like in the panel (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Older), played right in the app, with length, with or without singing, the time or day, swipe to delete. At the top "What kind of music?" with the length to pick (the same lengths as the chips in the panel, up to the admin's limit) makes a piece without singing; singing and own lyrics work in the panel under Me → Music. - Memory: all remembered facts with search, "learned from a conversation" or "said yourself" with the date. S

head: My things
title: My things
text: wipe to change or delete, "Select" deletes several, "Suggest tidying up" asks the language model about double entries, and only your "Accept" changes anything. Forgetting everything at once stays in the browser.

head: My things
title: Calendar and e-mail
text: Calendar and e-mail (since V01.0.815, plan kalender-mail/plan.md stage 4): at the top of My things there are "Kalender" and "E-Mail" when the admin released the function for you (Calendar, Reading e-mail; without the panel switch). The calendar shows the appointments of four weeks from this week by day, in the colour of their calendar; "+" adds an appointment, a tap shows it with "Change" and "Delete" (only in own CalDAV calendars, never for repeating or shared ones; the Spark checks the rules like on the page). E-mail shows the inbox of all mailboxes (the 50 newest), a tap the mail as plain text (it stays unread); with "Order mail" below it read/unread, archive and move, with "Send mail" "Reply" and "New mail" at the top, both with the Spark's preview sheet, sent only with "Send" there. With "Apps keep the last state" the appointments of the four weeks, the mail list (sender, subject, time) and up to 20 mails opened last with their text stay on the iPhone; when the function is off the app deletes them on the next opening, on unpairing and for another profile at once.

head: My things
title: Calendar and e-mail as in the panel
text: Calendar and e-mail as in the panel (V01.0.830, Dominik 2026-10-19 "a"): the calendar has "Quick add" on top: one line like "Tomorrow 3 pm dentist at Dr. White", the Spark reads it with fixed rules and shows title, day, time and place; only "Add" saves, into your first own calendar. An appointment now has "+1 day" and "+1 week" next to "Change" and "Delete", then "Undo" while the sheet is open. E-mail shows the list by day (Today, Yesterday, …) with the sender's initials; with "Order mail" you swipe left to archive and right for read or unread. Below a mail, "As appointment" makes a line for Quick add from the subject. Sharing calendars stays in the browser for safety (Calendar → Settings), like connecting accounts.

head: My things
title: Folders in e-mail
text: Folders in e-mail (mail client stage A, with "Mails ordnen"): the folder button top left in E-mail opens every folder of your mailboxes with the number of unread mails; a tap shows the folder like the inbox. "New folder" per mailbox, an own folder can be renamed or, when empty, removed by swiping or a long press (with the code). "Select" (⋯ top right) ticks several mails: Read, Flag, Archive, Move. Flag also by swiping and in the mail; a mail is never deleted.

head: My things
title: Rules in e-mail
text: Rules in e-mail (mail client stage B, with "Mails ordnen"): "Rules" in E-mail shows every rule (swipe: Pause, Delete, Move up), "Rule from this …" in a mail fills in sender and subject (without Re:/AW:/Fwd:, free to change). When sender, subject, recipient or attachment match, then folder, read, flag or not in "For you". "Dry run" only counts; after saving you can sort the existing mails (with the code) and bring them back with "Undo".

head: My things
title: Search, attachments and forwarding in e-mail
text: Search, attachments and forwarding in e-mail (mail client stage C): the search field above the list also knows von:, betreff:, hat:anhang, ist:markiert (as suggestions to tap). A mail's attachments open by a tap in the preview, from there share or save them (with "Mails ordnen"). "Forward" puts the mail below your lines, the attachments if wanted; it is sent only from the preview.

head: My things
title: E-mail like Apple Mail
text: E-mail like Apple Mail (V01.0.874, plan apple-stil/plan.md stage 1): a mail has the head like Apple Mail on top (circle with the initials, name, time, address, to, the subject big). Mails with HTML are shown formatted as they were sent; the Spark cleans them first, the app shows them in a web view without script that loads nothing from the network (embedded pictures come along, pictures from outside stay off). A link opens in Safari only after the question with its address, mailto: opens a new mail. In dark mode a plain mail (without colours of its own) shows in light letters on a dark ground like Apple Mail, a mail with its own colours keeps its white page (V01.0.884; before, the content stayed empty because the web view's blocking rule did not compile). "Send" has the Spark check the mail and then waits 10 seconds with "Undo" and "Send now"; with text of the Spark (a suggestion, a rewrite, a draft from "For you") the preview comes first.

head: My things
title: Calendar like Apple Calendar
text: Calendar like Apple Calendar (V01.0.880, plan apple-stil/plan.md stage 2): on top a week strip with dots on days with appointments, below it the chosen day; a swipe sideways changes the day, on the strip the week, "Today" jumps back, top right switches to the list. "New Event" (+) is a form in groups like Apple's: title and place, all day, start, end, repeat with "Ends", calendar, alert, people (only a list, no invitation is sent), note and link. An appointment shows repeat, alert and people; "Edit" opens the same form. For a repeating appointment the app asks "This Event Only" or "All Future Events", also for "+1 day", "+1 week" and "Delete Event". After every save "Undo" stays in the view (two minutes, the Spark puts back the old state).

head: My things
title: Contacts like Apple Contacts
text: Contacts like Apple Contacts (V01.0.888, plan apple-stil/plan.md stage 3a): My things → Contacts (with "Contacts"): A to Z with search and a letter bar, the card with Message, Call, Mail, Event and Share (.vcf through the share menu), phone, e-mail, address, website, birthday, note and "With Anna". With "Edit contacts": "Edit", "+" for a new contact, remove fields by swiping, "add" per kind, "Delete contact" after asking; the Spark checks everything and writes the card back into its address book with its ETag. The address books are set up in the browser under Contacts → Settings.

head: My things
title: The iPhone's Contacts app
text: The iPhone's Contacts app (V01.0.897, stage 3b): with "Contacts for contacts apps" the iPhone's own Contacts app shows the address book "On the Spark" as a CardDAV account (setup in the help "Contacts for contacts apps"); with "Edit contacts" also for changing.

head: My things
title: Invitations from mail
text: Invitations from mail (V01.0.897): with "Invitations from mail" a mail with an invitation shows a section "Invitation" above the text with title, time, place and who invites; "Accept", "Maybe", "Decline" (for a cancellation by the organiser "Remove from calendar"), with several calendars a choice, with "Send mail" the switch "Send answer to …". The Spark checks and writes everything.

head: Messages to other profiles
title: Messages to other profiles
text: You write in Chats (button at the top right when chats are on). Since V01.0.488 the app has no messages window of its own and no notification with a reply field any more; new chat messages arrive as "💬 name" and open the app. With Siri: "Message with Spark" asks for recipient and text and confirms before sending; the message lands in the chat with that person, "everybody" in the group "Alle". The name must match a profile that takes your messages (name or call name). When several fit, Siri asks "Whom do you mean?" with at most 4 names; for an unknown name it says at most 3 similar ones. The Today card "Chats" counts unread chat messages. Who may write to you is set in the browser (Me → Conversation → Chats). Needs the next TestFlight build.

head: Messages to other profiles
title: Messages to other profiles
text: Since V01.0.654 chats in the app do as much as in the panel: changes arrive at once (over the same connection as the Chats page, only while the chats are open and the app is in front; otherwise notifications come as before), and the top shows "typing …". Long-press a message: React (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏, tapping again takes it away), Reply (with a quote; tapping the quote jumps there), Copy, Change (15 minutes) and Take back for everybody (1 hour). Further up "Older messages", a line per day, ✓ sent, ✓✓ delivered, blue ✓✓ read. ✎ at the top left starts a new chat or a new group (when group chats are on; you are its admin). The search field above the list searches your chats. Tapping the name at the top opens the chat info: mute (1 hour, 8 hours, always), messages disappear (24 hours, 7 or 90 days; in groups only the admins), for groups name, members (swipe left to make admin or remove), add people, clear chat for me and leave group. The same rules and limits as in the panel apply; the app can do nothing the profile may not do in the browser.

head: Messages to other profiles
title: Private chats (end-to-end)
text: Private chats (end-to-end) since V01.0.654: when they are on (Features → Chats → "Private chats (end-to-end)"), a new chat has the switch "Private (end-to-end)". The first time you tap "Add this iPhone": the iPhone makes its own key in the Secure Enclave (it never leaves the iPhone), the Spark only gets the public half; with a second login step the app asks for the code. The iPhone encrypts texts, photos (drawn anew first, no place or camera data) and files itself, exactly like the browser and the Android app. The chat info shows the safety number to compare and "Your devices" (swipe left to remove). If you already have another device, the iPhone waits for the history and shows a code; on the older device tap "Transfer" when it shows the same code. The other way round the app shows "🔒 New device" on top of the chats with the code, "Transfer" and "Not me". Unpairing deletes the app's key.

head: Voice and video calls
title: Voice and video calls
text: Since V01.0.652 the app makes calls itself: a chat between two people on this Spark shows 📞 and 🎥 at the top. An incoming call rings the iPhone like a normal call, also when locked and with the app closed (Apple's call screen with "Spark"). During the call: mute, camera off, switch camera, speaker, hang up. Afterwards the call shows in the chat ("📞 Call · 3:12", "Missed call", "Call declined"); on purpose not in the Phone app's call list. With the app open it also rings without Apple's VoIP push (since V01.0.705): it listens to the Spark's news itself. The same fixed rules as in the browser apply (only people who take your messages, not in quiet hours, 45 seconds of ringing); the other end can be a browser, the Android app or an iPhone. When another device of the same profile answers, the iPhone stops ringing.

head: Voice and video calls
title: Voice and video calls
text: With Calls by the assistant (V01.0.803), "Call Sabine" and the "Yes" in the app's assistant start the call right away through Apple's call screen. When the call was asked for at a speaker or on the phone, the app asks "Call Sabine?" when opened. "Call Mum by phone" works through the iPhone contacts as before.

head: Voice and video calls
title: Voice and video calls
text: Needs: Features → Chats → Calls (voice and video) (admin; from outside the home also "Calls when away") and Push to the iPhone app (otherwise it only rings while the app is open), plus the next TestFlight build. On the first call the iPhone asks for microphone and camera.

head: Where the Spark is listening (room mode)
title: Where the Spark is listening (room mode)
text: Since V01.0.209 the app shows when a device of your profile listens in room mode (browser or speaker). Switch it on in the panel under Me → iPhone app → "Raum-Modus in der App zeigen" (show room mode in the app) (off, needs room mode from the admin). The top of the chat then reads "● Küche hört zu bis 21:30" with "Beenden", with several devices one line that opens a list. The app asks when it opens, when it comes back and every 30 seconds. The lock screen and the Dynamic Island show a Live Activity with the time left and "Beenden" (turn off in the iPhone Settings → Spark → Live Activities). It is only updated while the app runs; after the end time it reads "vorbei" until the app looks again. The "Raum-Modus" widget (home and lock screen) shows "Küche hört zu bis 21:30" or "Niemand hört zu". With Siri: "End room mode with Spark". The app can only end room mode, never start it; it sees only where and until when, never what was heard.

head: Spark update from the app
title: Spark update from the app
text: For chosen profiles, off by default. The admin switches on Features → Spark update from the iPhone app and ticks per profile:

head: Spark update from the app
title: Spark update from the app
text: - Notices: when a new version with green GitHub tests is ready, a notification arrives on the iPhone, once per version and not during the profile's quiet time. Needs "Push to the iPhone app". - Start: the app shows "Update now" under Settings → Spark version, confirmed with Face ID (or the iPhone passcode) and a fresh code from the profile's authenticator app, so "Start" can only be ticked for profiles with the second login step.

head: Spark update from the app
title: Spark update from the app
text: The page shows the installed and the new version with its changes. The update runs as in the panel: a backup, then update.sh, which installs only versions with green tests. The app follows the progress and the restart. At most one start from the app every 10 minutes; the other profiles with notices hear who started it. Going back to the old version stays in the panel (Settings → Update).

head: Push notifications with the app closed
title: Push notifications with the app closed
text: 1. developer.apple.com → Certificates, IDs & Profiles → Keys → + → tick Apple Push Notifications service (APNs) → Continue → Register → Download. The .p8 file can be downloaded only once. The Key ID is shown next to it, the Team ID under Membership. 2. Panel as admin: Features → Push to the iPhone app on, enter .p8, Key ID, Team ID and the app's bundle ID. Kind of app: "Development" while you install from Xcode, "Production" for TestFlight and the App Store. Save. 3. Profile: nothing to do, "Notifications to the iPhone" is on from the start. It can be switched off under Me → iPhone app → "Notifications to the iPhone". 4. Open the app once and allow notifications, then "Send a test message" in the panel.

head: Push notifications with the app closed
title: Push notifications with the app closed
text: Then reminders and timers (also those set in the panel or on a speaker), the morning briefing, notes and memory tidying arrive with the app closed. Only "Neue Nachricht vom Spark" goes through Apple; the text stays on the Spark for 24 hours and the app fetches it with its key. Tapping opens the app with the note as a card above the conversation: the whole text, the time and the button that fits (Open card, open chat, read mail, copy code or the way in the text); older than a day, the card says so (V01.0.960). With push, reminders no longer ring twice. At most 30 notifications per hour and profile.

head: Push notifications with the app closed
title: Push notifications with the app closed
text: The test says BadDeviceToken: "Development" and "Production" are swapped. InvalidProviderToken: Key ID or Team ID do not match the key. TopicDisallowed: the bundle ID does not match.

head: CarPlay
title: CarPlay
text: An own "Spark" icon in the car. Tap → "Mit Spark sprechen" → talk. The conversation goes on hands-free until no voice comes for 15 seconds; interrupting works as in the app. In the car a quieter voice over the road noise counts too, and only a pause of 1.6 seconds ends a question, so Spark does not stop in mid-sentence (since V01.0.734). The car shows only the state, never text, with the profile's face (robot or comic, as in the app) as a still picture matching the state; when only the car starts the app, it asks the Spark for the face itself (since V01.0.676; Apple allows no animation in CarPlay). Answers are short in the car. Smart home in the car only with its own switch "Smart home in the car too" and the code word. Route and call only after "Ja".

head: CarPlay
title: Apple's grant
text: Apple's grant: Apple granted the CarPlay category "Voice-based conversational app"; it is ticked for the App ID io.github.db9979.speechspark under developer.apple.com → Identifiers → Additional Capabilities (CarPlay Voice Based Conversation), and since V01.0.676 ios/Spark.entitlements contains com.apple.developer.carplay-voice-based-conversation. The TestFlight build fetches the matching profile itself; without the tick on the App ID the build cannot be signed. If the icon does not appear: iPhone → Settings → General → CarPlay → your car → Customize, add Spark. Try it without a car: Simulator → I/O → External Displays → CarPlay.

head: CarPlay
title: CarPlay
text: When the icon does not show: iPhone → Settings → General → CarPlay → your car → Customize, add Spark there.

head: CarPlay
title: CarPlay
text: Trying it without a car: Xcode → Open Developer Tool → Simulator, there I/O → External Displays → CarPlay.

head: CarPlay
title: Reading appointments and mail aloud
text: Reading appointments and mail aloud (since V01.0.815): with Calendar or Reading e-mail released, the car also shows "Termine vorlesen" and "Neue Mails vorlesen". A tap asks the assistant ("What is on today and tomorrow?", "Do I have new mail?"), the answer is spoken; as always the car shows no text.

head: CarPlay
title: Stable in the car
text: Stable in the car (since V01.0.871): - The voice window ("Listening", "Thinking", "Spark speaks") opens and closes one step at a time. head: Security
title: Security
text: - Each iPhone gets its own key when pairing, kept only in that iPhone's keychain and on the Spark only as a hash. - The key may only ask and listen (chat, speech recognition, Siri question). Settings, memory, devices, connections and further pairings are refused. - When the admin blocks a profile (People and devices → Blocked functions), all its iPhones are locked at once, the admin switch locks all of them. Remove a lost iPhone under Me → iPhone app → Remove. - Smart home from the app only with its own switch and the code word. What the app claims to be does not count; the panel decides by the key. - Wake word, stand mode, routes and calls only with their own switch in the panel. The Spark only suggests a route or call; the tool exists only for the app key with the switch, and only your "yes" on the iPhone starts it. Outside text (mail, web page) cannot start a route or call. - No sound goes to the Spark before the wake word. In the background the app listens only with the wake word on. - Push: the Apple key (.p8) is stored encrypted, changed only by the admin with the second step, never shown again. Apple only gets a fixed sentence and a random number. Only the app with its own k

head: Security
title: Security
text: ey signs up its push address; a removed iPhone gets nothing from then on. Only the profile's own app gets a notification's text. - Photos and documents: the iPhone reads the text, only text goes to the Spark (at most 20,000 characters per question). Photos go as pictures only with the photo switch on; a round with a picture offers no tools, and the picture is not kept in the history. The Spark treats it as outside text: it sits as data in the prompt, not in the conversation, and locks actions as after a mail. The history keeps only the attachment's name. - Storing documents only with its own switch, only with the app key, at most 10 per minute and 3 MB. The app cannot list or delete the documents. - "My profile" changes only a fixed list (voice, speed, length, by itself, morning briefing). The app's rights, Telegram, the smart home and the tone cannot be changed through it; a request with any other field is refused as a whole. - Apple Reminders: only with its own switch, only after "yes" on the iPhone. The app reads nothing from Reminders for the Spark. Shortcuts may only add entries to the lists; list settings stay in the panel. - Sharing: shared content is outside text (locks act

head: Security
title: Security
text: ions), at most 20,000 characters per question; the iPhone loads web pages itself, at most 3 MB. - Waiting questions stay on the iPhone and are deleted when unpairing. - Last state (admin switch chat.app_cache, on in the basic set, blockable per profile): the app keeps only while GET /api/iphone/hello says "keep"; when the Spark says no it deletes everything at once. The files lie in the app's own storage with data protection "complete" (unreadable while locked), never in an iCloud or computer backup, in one folder per pairing (its name is a hash of address and key, never the key). Unpairing, a new pairing and another profile delete everything. Never kept: keys, codes, "Manage Spark", private and vanishing chats, files and pictures. Kept rights switch nothing on (microphone, push, calls, Apple Reminders wait for the Spark's answer). - Spark update: only the admin gives the rights (with the admin's code when the second step is on); a profile cannot give them to itself. Starting needs the app's key, Face ID and a fresh 6-digit code of the profile (each code once, wrong codes count towards the lock), at most once in 10 minutes. The app cannot pick a version; only versions with passed G

head: Security
title: Security
text: itHub tests are installed. Every start is in the security log, and the language model has no tool for it. - CarPlay never loosens anything: in the car the smart home is locked without its own car switch. - Calls: sound and picture travel encrypted (DTLS-SRTP) directly between the devices or through the Spark's own relay, never through Apple. When ringing, Apple only gets a random number; name and kind the app fetches from the Spark with its key. The app key reaches only the call paths (start, answer, signal, end, info, ICE), and only for calls its profile takes part in. The language model cannot start a call. - Private chats: the iPhone's key lives in the Secure Enclave and never leaves it; the Spark only sees encrypted messages. A new key needs the second step's code, like a new device. - Pairing only from the profile's own browser login, with the second login step when the profile has it. At most 5 iPhones per profile.

head: What the Spark offers for it
title: What the Spark offers for it
text: Every push that changes ios/ builds the app on GitHub for the simulator (.github/workflows/ios.yml), so errors show there and not only in Xcode.

head: Publishing the iPhone app
title: Publishing the iPhone app
text: Three ways, from the simplest to the most work. All need the Apple Developer Program (99 €/year).

head: 1. Once: create the app at Apple
title: 1. Once: create the app at Apple
text: 1. Check in Xcode: project Spark → Build Settings → APP_BUNDLE_ID is your own bundle ID (e.g. io.github.db9979.speechspark.dominik). Both targets (Spark and SparkNotify) have your team selected under Signing & Capabilities. 2. appstoreconnect.apple.com → Apps → + → New App: platform iOS, a name (it must be free in the App Store; "Spark" is surely taken, e.g. "Spark voice assistant"), primary language, the bundle ID from the list, any SKU (e.g. speechspark).

head: 2. Upload every new version
title: 2. Upload every new version
text: 1. git pull in the repo. 2. Xcode → target Spark → General: raise Version (e.g. 1.1) when something changes for users. The Build number counts up by itself: building sets it to the number of commits in the repo, the same for the app and all its extensions, so it is larger after every git pull. The app shows both small at the bottom, e.g. "1.0 (412)". 3. Choose Any iOS Device (arm64) as the destination at the top. 4. Product → Archive. After a few minutes the Organizer opens. 5. Distribute App → App Store Connect → Distribute. Xcode signs and uploads. 6. After 5–30 minutes the build shows in App Store Connect under TestFlight. The app answers the encryption question itself (https only, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO).

head: 2. Upload every new version
title: 2. Upload every new version
text: Then set the kind to "Production" in the panel under Features → Push to the iPhone app: TestFlight and App Store builds use Apple's production push. Installed straight from Xcode it is "Development" again.

head: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
title: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
text: Instead of Archive and Distribute on the Mac this also works on GitHub. The button builds the app, lets Apple sign it and uploads it to TestFlight. It starts only for a commit whose tests passed. The build number counts up by itself.

head: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
title: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
text: Once: 1. App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → Team Keys: create a key with role Admin. Only Admin may fetch certificates for signing. If you already have an App Manager key for the texts, replace it with this one. 2. GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions: ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY (the whole content of the .p8 file) and also ASC_TEAM_ID (developer.apple.com → Membership → Team ID).

head: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
title: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
text: Then: GitHub → Actions → TestFlight → Run workflow, enter the bundle ID, Run. After 15 to 30 minutes the build is in App Store Connect under TestFlight.

head: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
title: Automatic
text: Automatic: when a commit on main changes something under ios/, TestFlight starts by itself as soon as "iPhone app" and "Tests" passed. At most one upload per hour. It waits up to 100 minutes for "Tests", because Tests on main run one after another (V01.0.965). If a newer iOS commit comes in the waiting time, only that one is uploaded. If a newer push cancelled the tests of the iOS commit, the newest main commit with passed tests that contains the iOS commit goes up (V01.0.321). The certificates a run makes for itself are revoked again at its end, otherwise Apple's limit is reached after some dozen runs ("reached the maximum number of certificates", V01.0.334). If that message still shows in a run, revoke the old entries under developer.apple.com → Certificates. Turn it off: GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables → TESTFLIGHT_AUTO = off. A bundle ID other than io.github.db9979.speechspark goes into the variable APP_BUNDLE_ID. To start again always use Run workflow, not "Re-run", because a re-run builds the old commit.

head: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
title: Upload with the GitHub button "TestFlight"
text: If it does not work the first time, send the red line from the run.

head: 3. TestFlight (recommended for you and the family)
title: 3. TestFlight (recommended for you and the family)
text: 1. App Store Connect → Users and Access: invite family members with their Apple ID (a role like "Marketing" is enough). 2. App → TestFlight → Internal Testing → + → create a group "Family", add the people, assign the build. 3. Everybody installs the TestFlight app from the App Store on the iPhone and accepts the invitation. New builds arrive there by themselves.

head: 3. TestFlight (recommended for you and the family)
title: 3. TestFlight (recommended for you and the family)
text: A TestFlight build runs 90 days; then simply upload a new one.

head: 4. App Store (only when strangers should load the app)
title: 4. App Store (only when strangers should load the app)
text: In addition to steps 1–2, in App Store Connect under the app:

head: 4. App Store (only when strangers should load the app)
title: 4. App Store (only when strangers should load the app)
text: - Screenshots: at least for 6.9" (iPhone 16 Pro Max) or 6.5", from the simulator with ⌘S. - Description, keywords, support URL (e.g. the GitHub page). - Privacy policy (URL): ready in app-privacy.md, German in app-datenschutz.md. Enter the GitHub link of the file as the URL. - App Privacy: "Data Not Collected" (everything goes to the user's own Spark, not to you). Notifications through Apple carry only a fixed sentence. - Age rating: fill in the questionnaire (no content of the categories → 4+; because of the free answers of a language model rather 12+). - Notes for the review: Apple's reviewers need a Spark. Create a test profile of its own such as "App Review" and make a review access under People and devices → Review access for the iPhone app (valid 14 days). In the sign-in details put the address of your reverse proxy as the user name and the review code as the password, and add: "On the first screen tap 'Connect with a review code', type address and code. Without access, 'Look without a Spark' shows a demo." A short video of the app helps as well. - Availability: request "Unlisted" (by link only) at Apple when the app should not show up in the App Store search.

head: Fill in the texts automatically
title: Fill in the texts automatically
text: Name, subtitle, promotional text, description, keywords, URLs and categories (German and English) are in ios/fastlane/metadata. A button on GitHub writes them into App Store Connect. It uploads no build and no pictures and submits nothing for review.

head: Fill in the texts automatically
title: Fill in the texts automatically
text: 1. The app must already exist in App Store Connect (step 1), with German as the primary language. 2. App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → Team Keys → +: name "GitHub texts", role App Manager. Download the .p8 file (works only once), note the Key ID and the Issuer ID. 3. GitHub → repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret, three times: ASC_KEY_ID (Key ID), ASC_ISSUER_ID (Issuer ID), ASC_KEY (the whole content of the .p8 file). 4. GitHub → Actions → App Store texts → Run workflow: enter bundle ID, version (1.0) and copyright (e.g. 2026 First Last), Run. 5. After about 2 minutes the texts are in App Store Connect. You can revoke the key there afterwards.

head: Fill in the texts automatically
title: Fill in the texts automatically
text: The screenshots (German and English, 6.9" and 6.3") are made by the workflow App Store screenshots in the iPhone simulator with example content. It puts them on the branch app-store-screenshots. With the box "upload screenshots too" ticked, App Store texts enters them as well. The demo mode (-SparkDemo) exists only in the test build, not in the app from the store.

head: Fill in the texts automatically
title: Fill in the texts automatically
text: Left by hand: App Privacy, age rating, notes for the review and price. The answers for them are in the project's papers ("App Store Connect: Angaben für Spark").

head: Fill in the texts automatically
title: Fill in the texts automatically
text: Then Submit for Review. The review usually takes 1–3 days. A frequent rejection: the reviewer gets no further because they have no Spark (guideline 2.1), hence the video and the test access.

head: CarPlay
title: CarPlay
text: Builds with CarPlay can only be uploaded once Apple granted the CarPlay entitlement and it is entered in ios/Spark.entitlements (see iphone-app.md). Until then upload builds without that line; everything else works.

head: Security
title: Security
text: - Assistant without password: off on new installs. Then only profiles (name and PIN) and devices with a key reach the assistant. Switch under *Settings → Security*. - Lockout after wrong attempts: after 5 wrong passwords or PINs from one address (or 10 for one profile name or the admin password, from anywhere) the panel waits 1 minute, twice as long with every further lockout, at most an hour. On top, each name gets at most 30 wrong attempts a day. A browser that logged in successfully with that name before is not locked out by a stranger this way, also not on the road with a new address (cookie speech_known). Since V01.0.402 only the browser counts, not the address and not a login with another profile: a housemate with a profile of their own cannot guess another profile's PIN without the lock. The counts survive a restart of the panel and are pruned, so made-up names cannot grow them without end. - Reverse proxy: behind a reverse proxy in the LAN (e.g. Synology) the real address from X-Forwarded-For counts, so one guesser cannot lock everybody out. Enter the proxy's address under *Settings → Security → Adressen des Reverse-Proxys* (reverse proxy addresses); the panel trusts that h

title: Security
text: eader only from there. Without an entry it counts only from a proxy on the Spark itself; proxies in the home network then share one address for the lockout (the panel log says "X-Forwarded-For … ignored"). - Logins expire: the admin login after 7 days without use, a profile login after 30 days (7–90 under *Settings → Security → Sign-in in the browser*, since V01.0.262); while in use they renew themselves. Logging out ends the login on the server too. *Me → Security → Log out everywhere* ends the profile's login in all other browsers. On https (also behind the proxy) the cookies are Secure. - Signed-in browsers (since V01.0.262): *Me → Security* lists every browser the profile is signed in to (only a short name like "iPhone · Safari", first and last use, no address), with *Sign out* for each one; the admin sees the same list in the profile details. At most 20 per profile, the oldest ends first. Logins from before V01.0.262 appear after their next use. - Browser protection (since V01.0.262): every panel answer forbids embedding in other pages (X-Frame-Options, frame-ancestors), guessing file types (nosniff), leaking addresses to other sites (Referrer-Policy) and microphone/camera for

text: anything but the panel (Permissions-Policy); over https Strict-Transport-Security is added. - Strict Content-Security-Policy (since V01.0.286): scripts only run as files from the panel (script-src 'self'): no script in the page, no onclick="…" handlers, no eval. So even injected HTML runs no code. Buttons in generated lists name their function with data-on (base.js ON); only what is registered there can be called. Pictures and sound also from data:/blob: (recordings, QR codes, the face), connections only to the panel itself, no foreign frames. Kept are the last 50 saved changes from Settings, Features and the iPhone app's switches (state/config-undo.json, only names and short values). head: Security
title: Security
text: - New people by invitation (since V01.0.276, *People and devices → New people*, off): invitation only, there is no open sign-up. The admin creates an invitation (suggested name, valid 1, 7 or 30 days) and gets a link, a QR code and a card to print; the link needs the panel's https address. Every link works once, the Spark keeps only its fingerprint (SHA-256), at most 50 are open, used ones disappear 7 days after acceptance or at once with the deleted profile (its PIN links too), expired ones after 30 days. Wrong codes count towards the lockout; whether a name is taken is only told to someone with a valid code. The PIN needs at least 6 characters. There are no starter packs any more: what the admin releases works for the new profile at once too. Second step: by default "required for e-mail, documents, jobs"; a profile from an invitation gets these three only after setting up the second sign-in step and cannot switch it off itself afterwards (fixed check in the panel, reason "mfa" under Me and Blocked functions). The main admin gets a push message for every new person. The profile details have PIN link (a new PIN by link instead of passing a PIN on; with the second step only with a c

head: Security
title: Security
text: in the history: the next turn starts locked, and the assistant learns nothing about the owner from it. Answers made from outside text keep that mark at the Pebble watch too. Document cards in the system prompt are cut short; documents shared by other profiles show only file name, kind and tags. Only a speaker's own key opens the speaker connection. A restore by the owner profile leaves the panel password and its second step unchanged. /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json are gone. Guests get only error codes from speech recognition, and reading aloud has its own limits for guests. Removing devices and "Sign out everywhere" from the iPhone app, and "Continue on the phone", need a code when the second step is on. After outside text, "From phone to PC" puts no text into the clipboard and sends only plain links. Own MCP services cannot reach the Spark's service ports via its LAN address either. An MCP client switches nothing when a smart-home code word is set, and MCP actions are only proposed with arguments that are read out in full before the "yes". - Code check of 19.10.2026 (plan code-pruefung/plan.md, V01.0.825, Dominik "2b"): admin password and PINs with PBKDF2-SHA256 and 600,000 roun

head: Security
title: Security
text: ds (OWASP); older hashes keep working and are computed anew at the next sign-in, a profile's other browsers stay signed in (signed with the old hash until the PIN changes), with the admin password the other admin browsers sign in once more. Whoever then goes back to a version before V01.0.825 no longer gets in with password or PIN and uses sudo speech-spark notzugang. The own https server speaks only TLS 1.2 or newer (panel.tls_context). The sentry always reports a new way in, changed protection and a changed log at once; the daily cap holds only for lockouts. Watch answers (/api/watch/poll, report, cancel) only for the profile that asked. The day's count of sent mails survives a restart (state/mail-gesendet.json). "Undo" when ordering mail takes only a real Message-ID (tidy.clean_mid in find_mid). The Werkstatt sandbox on tars reaches only the LLM-Tor (see Werkstatt). The scanner test no longer counts assistant and an _on without a profile as a login.

head: Ways in
title: Ways in
text: Everything that reaches the panel from outside, and who may do what there. Every way is closed by default or needs a sign-in, each counts against a rate limit and writes fixed words to the log. A new way in goes into this list and onto the node page "Security" (Status → Architecture) in the same commit.

head: Data on the disk and new ways to write
title: Data on the disk and new ways to write
text: - Supplies sealed (since V01.0.872/879): what a service read for a profile lies sealed (vault) in the profile as a supply, so answers come with "as of …" during an outage: mail supply (mail-vorrat.bin, headers and up to 40 mail texts without attachments), weather, parcel and for-you supply. Not in the backup, "Delete data" removes them. All files: Architecture → data storage. - Unclear questions, anonymous (since V01.0.927, switch "Keep unclear questions anonymously" under Features → Targeted tool choice, off; preference per profile under Me → Conversation → Privacy): questions no rule of the switch recognizes are kept only redacted (fixed rules as in "Report a problem", plus address book names and every number, a second leak check drops) and sealed in state/weiche-unklar.json: without profile, device and time of day, at most 100, gone after 7 days, not in the backup. Never a sentence with the code word, never guests. Only admin and co-admin see and delete them on Features → Routing. - Edit contacts (since V01.0.888, switch "Edit contacts", off): changes go only into the profile's own address book and only with If-Match (ETag); when the card changed meanwhile, the Spark overwrites

head: Data on the disk and new ways to write
title: Data on the disk and new ways to write
text: nothing. New cards go into the chosen book or "On the Spark". - Search at the mail server (since V01.0.887): what you type into the search field becomes IMAP SEARCH words; only letters, digits, @, . and - get in, never a quote, a word beyond ASCII as a UTF-8 literal. Only the own mailboxes are searched. - Hero book to the reMarkable (since V01.1.143, switch under Features → AI Dungeon Master, off): A hero's book leaves the Spark only on the reMarkable's way (its cloud, remarkable.place, daily limits). It holds only the panel's data: catalog, hero values, the own chronicle of fixed kinds and numbers, of people only what was unlocked, of fellow heroes only name, people and class; never a text of the model. Pictures are opened again with Pillow under a pixel and byte bound. State users/<id>/dungeon-buch.json, "Delete data" removes it.

head: Securing the repository and releases
title: Securing the repository and releases
text: Since V01.0.390. The GitHub workflows pin every action to a commit (Dependabot proposes updates monthly), only the job that writes a release or build branch may write, and actions/checkout keeps no token. The signing keys (Android keystore, App Store Connect key, Developer ID) live in the environment release, usable only by workflows on main; workflows on other branches cannot see them. The self-test test_workflows keeps it that way.

head: Securing the repository and releases
title: Securing the repository and releases
text: One-time move of the keys: create a fine-grained token for this repository only (Administration, Environments, Secrets: read and write, valid 1 day), store it as repository secret MIGRATE_TOKEN and run the workflow "Schlüssel in Umgebung verschieben". It creates release (main only, no review), copies every key that is set, then deletes the repository copies and MIGRATE_TOKEN. Values never appear in the log.

head: Securing the repository and releases
title: Securing the repository and releases
text: Recommended on GitHub: 2FA with a passkey, a ruleset on main against deletion and force push, read-only workflow permissions, secret scanning with push protection. tars still installs only commits whose tests passed and refuses rewritten history.

head: Device updates and supply chain (since V01.0.407)
title: Device updates and supply chain (since V01.0.407)
text: - Releases only from the environment release: the jobs that publish the speaker firmware and the Windows companion run in the environment release (main only) too; new firmware rolls out to every speaker at night. The ESP-IDF image is pinned to its digest, pebble-tool and Playwright to a fixed version; the Pebble SDK itself still comes as "latest" (its list could not be reached when this version was built). The token for the branch pebble-build goes through an environment variable, never into the Git URL. - Signed manifests (prepared, off): the workflows sign manifest.json (firmware) and begleiter.json (Windows, Mac) with Ed25519 once the secret UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY exists in the environment release, and put <file>.sig into the release. The Spark checks the signature once a public key is listed in app/panel/signatur.py; then it takes nothing unsigned. Without a key nothing changes: GitHub over https plus SHA-256 and size from the manifest. Setting it up: openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -out update-key.pem, store the content as secret UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY under *GitHub → Settings → Environments → release*, run a build and put the public key shown in its log into signatur.KEYS (only on
